verses.sa:
अग्निर्नः शत्रून् प्रत्येतु विद्वान् प्रतिदहन्न् अभिशस्तिमरातिम् ।
स सेनां मोहयतु परेषां निर्हस्तांश्च कृणवज्जातवेदाः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirnah shatrun pratyetu vidvan pratidahann abhishastimaratim |
sa senam mohayatu paresham nirhastamshcha krinavajjatavedah ||
verses.en: Let Agni, knowing, go against our foes, burning against the imprecator, the niggard; let him confound (mohaya-) the army of our adversaries (pára); and may Jātavedas make them handless.

verses.sa:
यूयमुग्रा मरुत ईदृशे स्थाभि प्रेत मृणत सहध्वम् ।
अमीमृणन् वसवो नाथिता इमे अग्निर्ह्येषां दूतः प्रत्येतु विद्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
yuyamugra maruta idrishe sthabhi preta mrinata sahadhvam |
amimrinan vasavo nathita ime agnirhyesham dutah pratyetu vidvan ||
verses.en: Ye, O Maruts, are formidable for such a plight; go forward upon [them], kill, overcome! The Vasus have killed [them]; suppliant [are] these; for let Agni, their messenger, go against [their foes], knowing.

verses.sa:
अमित्रसेनां मघवन्न् अस्मान् छत्रूयतीमभि ।
युवं तामिन्द्र वृत्रहन्न् अग्निश्च दहतं प्रति ॥
verses.rom:
amitrasenam maghavann asman chhatruyatimabhi |
yuvam tamindra vritrahann agnishcha dahatam prati ||
verses.en: The army of enemies, O bounteous one, playing the foe against us—do ye (two), O Vṛtra-slaying Indra, Agni also, burn against them.

verses.sa:
प्रसूत इन्द्र प्रवता हरिभ्यां प्र ते वज्रः प्रमृणन्न् एतु शत्रून् ।
जहि प्रतीचो अनूचः पराचो विष्वक्सत्यं कृणुहि चित्तमेषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
prasuta indra pravata haribhyam pra te vajrah pramrinann etu shatrun |
jahi praticho anuchah paracho vishvaksatyam krinuhi chittamesham ||
verses.en: Impelled, O Indra, forwards (? pravátā) by thy (two) bays—let thy thunderbolt go forth, slaughtering (pra-mṛ) the foes; smite the on-coming, the following, the fleeing (párāñc); scatter their actual intent.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र सेनां मोहयामित्राणाम् ।
अग्नेर्वातस्य ध्राज्या तान् विषूचो वि नाशय ॥
verses.rom:
indra senam mohayamitranam |
agnervatasya dhrajya tan vishucho vi nashaya ||
verses.en: O Indra, confound the army of our enemies; with the blast of fire, of wind, make them disappear, scattering.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सेनां मोहयतु मरुतो घ्नन्त्वोजसा ।
चक्षूंस्यग्निरा दत्तां पुनरेतु पराजिता ॥
verses.rom:
indrah senam mohayatu maruto ghnantvojasa |
chakshumsyagnira dattam punaretu parajita ||
verses.en: Let Indra confound the army; let the Maruts slay with force; let Agni take away its eyes; let it go back conquered.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्नो दूतः प्रत्येतु विद्वान् प्रतिदहन्न् अभिशस्तिमरातिम् ।
स चित्तानि मोहयतु परेषां निर्हस्तांश्च कृणवज्जातवेदाः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirno dutah pratyetu vidvan pratidahann abhishastimaratim |
sa chittani mohayatu paresham nirhastamshcha krinavajjatavedah ||
verses.en: Let Agni our messenger, knowing, go against [them], burning against the imprecator, the niggard; let him confound the intents of our adversaries; and may Jātavedas make them handless.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निरमूमुहद्यानि चित्तानि वो हृदि ।
वि वो धमत्वोकसः प्र वो धमतु सर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagniramumuhadyani chittani vo hridi |
vi vo dhamatvokasah pra vo dhamatu sarvatah ||
verses.en: Agni here hath confounded the intents that are in your heart; let him blow (dham) you away from [our] home; let him blow you forth in every direction.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र चित्तानि मोहयन्न् अर्वाङाकूत्या चर ।
अग्नेर्वातस्य ध्राज्या तान् विषूचो वि नाशय ॥
verses.rom:
indra chittani mohayann arvanakutya chara |
agnervatasya dhrajya tan vishucho vi nashaya ||
verses.en: O Indra! confounding [their] intents, move hitherward with [their] design (ā́kūti); with the blast of fire, of wind, make them disappear, scattering.

verses.sa:
व्याकूतय एषामिताथो चित्तानि मुह्यत ।
अथो यदद्यैषां हृदि तदेषां परि निर्जहि ॥
verses.rom:
vyakutaya eshamitatho chittani muhyata |
atho yadadyaisham hridi tadesham pari nirjahi ||
verses.en: Go asunder, ye designs of them; also, ye intents, be confounded; also what is today in their heart, that smite thou out from them.

verses.sa:
अमीषां चित्तानि प्रतिमोहयन्ती गृहाणाङ्गान्यप्वे परेहि ।
अभि प्रेहि निर्दह हृत्सु शोकैर्ग्राह्यामित्रांस्तमसा विध्य शत्रून् ॥
verses.rom:
amisham chittani pratimohayanti grihananganyapve parehi |
abhi prehi nirdaha hritsu shokairgrahyamitramstamasa vidhya shatrun ||
verses.en: Confounding the intents of those yonder, seizing their limbs, O Apvā, go away; go forth against [them]; consume [them] in their hearts with pangs (çóka); pierce the enemies with seizure (grā́hi), the foes with darkness.

verses.sa:
असौ या सेना मरुतः परेषामस्मान् ऐत्यभ्योजसा स्पर्धमाना ।
तां विध्यत तमसापव्रतेन यथैषामन्यो अन्यं न जानात् ॥
verses.rom:
asau ya sena marutah pareshamasman aityabhyojasa spardhamana |
tam vidhyata tamasapavratena yathaishamanyo anyam na janat ||
verses.en: Yonder army of our adversaries, O Maruts, that comes contending against us with force—pierce ye it with baffling darkness, that one of them may not know another.

verses.sa:
अचिक्रदत्स्वपा इह भुवदग्ने व्यचस्व रोदसी उरूची ।
युञ्जन्तु त्वा मरुतो विश्ववेदस आमुं नय नमसा रातहव्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
achikradatsvapa iha bhuvadagne vyachasva rodasi uruchi |
yunjantu tva maruto vishvavedasa amum naya namasa ratahavyam ||
verses.en: He hath shouted (? krand); may he be protector of his own here; O Agni, bend apart the two widened firmaments (ródasī); let the all-possessing Maruts harness (yuj) thee; lead thou hither with homage yon man of bestowed oblation.

verses.sa:
दूरे चित्सन्तमरुषास इन्द्रमा च्यावयन्तु सख्याय विप्रम् ।
यद्गायत्रीं बृहतीमर्कमस्मै सौत्रामण्या दधृषन्त देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
dure chitsantamarushasa indrama chyavayantu sakhyaya vipram |
yadgayatrim brihatimarkamasmai sautramanya dadhrishanta devah ||
verses.en: Indra, the inspired one, however far away, let the ruddy ones set in motion hither (ā-cyāvaya-) in order to friendship, when the gods venture (?) for him a gāyatrī́, a bṛhatī́, a song (arká), with the sāutrāmaṇī́ (ceremony).

verses.sa:
अद्भ्यस्त्वा राज वरुणो ह्वयतु सोमस्त्वा ह्वयतु पर्वतेभ्यः ।
इन्द्रस्त्वा ह्वयतु विड्भ्य आभ्यः श्येनो भूत्वा विश आ पतेमाः ॥
verses.rom:
adbhyastva raja varuno hvayatu somastva hvayatu parvatebhyah |
indrastva hvayatu vidbhya abhyah shyeno bhutva visha a patemah ||
verses.en: For the waters let king Varuṇa call thee; let Soma call thee for the mountains; let Indra call thee for these subjects (víç); becoming a falcon, fly unto these subjects.

verses.sa:
श्येनो हव्यं नयत्वा परस्मादन्यक्षेत्रे अपरुद्धं चरन्तम् ।
अश्विना पन्थां कृणुतां सुगं त इमं सजाता अभिसंविशध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
shyeno havyam nayatva parasmadanyakshetre aparuddham charantam |
ashvina pantham krinutam sugam ta imam sajata abhisamvishadhvam ||
verses.en: Let the falcon lead hither from far (pára) the one to be called, living exiled in others' territory (kṣétra); let the (two) Açvins make the road for thee easy to go; settle together about this man, ye his fellows.

verses.sa:
ह्वयन्तु त्वा प्रतिजनाः प्रति मित्रा अवृषत ।
इन्द्राग्नी विश्वे देवास्ते विशि क्षेममदीधरन् ॥
verses.rom:
hvayantu tva pratijanah prati mitra avrishata |
indragni vishve devaste vishi kshemamadidharan ||
verses.en: Let thine opponents call thee; thy friends have chosen [thee] against [them] (? práti); Indra-and-Agni, all the gods, have maintained for thee security (kṣéma) in the people (víç).

verses.sa:
यस्ते हवं विवदत्सजातो यश्च निष्ट्यः ।
अपाञ्चमिन्द्र तं कृत्वाथेममिहाव गमय ॥
verses.rom:
yaste havam vivadatsajato yashcha nishtyah |
apanchamindra tam kritvathemamihava gamaya ||
verses.en: Whatever fellow disputes thy call, and whatever outsider—making

verses.sa:
आ त्वा गन् राष्ट्रं सह वर्चसोदिहि प्राङ्विशां पतिरेकराट्त्वं वि राज ।
सर्वास्त्वा राजन् प्रदिशो ह्वयन्तूपसद्यो नमस्यो भवेह ॥
verses.rom:
a tva gan rashtram saha varchasodihi pranvisham patirekarattvam vi raja |
sarvastva rajan pradisho hvayantupasadyo namasyo bhaveha ||
verses.en: Unto thee hath come the kingdom; with splendor rise forward; [as] lord of the people (víças), sole king, bear thou rule (vi-rāj); let all the directions call thee, O king; become thou here one for waiting on, for homage.

verses.sa:
त्वां विशो वृणतां राज्याय त्वामिमाः प्रदिशः पञ्च देवीः ।
वर्ष्मन् राष्ट्रस्य ककुदि श्रयस्व ततो न उग्रो वि भजा वसूनि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam visho vrinatam rajyaya tvamimah pradishah pancha devih |
varshman rashtrasya kakudi shrayasva tato na ugro vi bhaja vasuni ||
verses.en: Thee let the people (víças) choose unto kingship (rājyà), thee these five divine directions; rest (çri) at the summit of royalty, at the pinnacle (kakúd); from thence, formidable, share out good things to us.

verses.sa:
अच्छ त्वा यन्तु हविनः सजाता अग्निर्दूतो अजिरः सं चरातै ।
जायाः पुत्राः सुमनसो भवन्तु बहुं बलिं प्रति पश्यासा उग्रः ॥
verses.rom:
achchha tva yantu havinah sajata agnirduto ajirah sam charatai |
jayah putrah sumanaso bhavantu bahum balim prati pashyasa ugrah ||
verses.en: Unto thee let thy fellows come, calling [thee]; Agni shall go along as speedy messenger; let the wives, the sons, be well-willing; thou, formidable, shalt see arrive (prati-paç) much tribute.

verses.sa:
अश्विना त्वाग्रे मित्रावरुणोभा विश्वे देवा मरुतस्त्वा ह्वयन्तु ।
अधा मनो वसुदेयाय कृणुष्व ततो न उग्रो वि भजा वसूनि ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina tvagre mitravarunobha vishve deva marutastva hvayantu |
adha mano vasudeyaya krinushva tato na ugro vi bhaja vasuni ||
verses.en: Let the (two) Açvins thee first,—let Mitra-and-Varuṇa both, let all the gods, the Maruts, call thee; then put (kṛ) thy mind unto the giving of good things; from thence, formidable, share out good things to us.

verses.sa:
आ प्र द्रव परमस्याः परावतः शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम् ।
तदयं राजा वरुणस्तथाह स त्वायमह्वत्स उपेदमेहि ॥
verses.rom:
a pra drava paramasyah paravatah shive te dyavaprithivi ubhe stam |
tadayam raja varunastathaha sa tvayamahvatsa upedamehi ||
verses.en: Run forth hither from the furthest distance; propitious to thee be heaven-and-earth both; king Varuṇa here saith this thus; he here hath called thee; therefore (sá) do thou come to this place.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेन्द्र मनुष्याः परेहि सं ह्यज्ञास्था वरुणैः संविदानः ।
स त्वायमह्वत्स्वे सधस्थे स देवान् यक्षत्स उ कल्पयद्विशः ॥
verses.rom:
indrendra manushyah parehi sam hyajnastha varunaih samvidanah |
sa tvayamahvatsve sadhasthe sa devan yakshatsa u kalpayadvishah ||
verses.en: Like a human Indra, go thou away; for thou hast concurred (sam-jñā) in concord with the castes (?); he here hath called thee in his own station; he shall sacrifice to the gods, and he shall arrange the people (víças).

verses.sa:
पथ्या रेवतीर्बहुधा विरूपाः सर्वाः संगत्य वरीयस्ते अक्रन् ।
तास्त्वा सर्वाः संविदाना ह्वयन्तु दशमीमुग्रः सुमना वशेह ॥
verses.rom:
pathya revatirbahudha virupah sarvah samgatya variyaste akran |
tastva sarvah samvidana hvayantu dashamimugrah sumana vasheha ||
verses.en: The wealthy roads, of manifoldly various form, all, assembling, have made wide room for thee; let them all in concord call thee; to the tenth [decade of life] abide here formidable, well-willing.

verses.sa:
आयमगन् पर्णमणिर्बली बलेन प्रमृणन्त्सपत्नान् ।
ओजो देवानां पय ओषधीनां वर्चसा मा जिन्वन्त्वप्रयावन् ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagan parnamanirbali balena pramrinantsapatnan |
ojo devanam paya oshadhinam varchasa ma jinvantvaprayavan ||
verses.en: Hither hath come this parṇá-amulet, strong, by strength slaughtering our rivals; force of the gods, milk of the herbs, let it quicken me with splendor unremittingly.

verses.sa:
मयि क्षत्रं पर्णमणे मयि धारयताद्रयिम् ।
अहं राष्ट्रस्याभीवर्गे निजो भूयासमुत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
mayi kshatram parnamane mayi dharayatadrayim |
aham rashtrasyabhivarge nijo bhuyasamuttamah ||
verses.en: In me [maintain] dominion, O parṇá-amulet, in me maintain wealth; may I in the sphere of royalty be familiar (? nijá), supreme.

verses.sa:
यं निदधुर्वनस्पतौ गुह्यं देवाः प्रियं मणिम् ।
तमस्मभ्यं सहायुषा देवा ददतु भर्तवे ॥
verses.rom:
yam nidadhurvanaspatau guhyam devah priyam manim |
tamasmabhyam sahayusha deva dadatu bhartave ||
verses.en: The dear amulet which the gods deposited hidden in the forest-tree—that let the gods give to us to wear, together with length of life (ā́yus).

verses.sa:
सोमस्य पर्णः सह उग्रमागन्न् इन्द्रेण दत्तो वरुणेन शिष्टः ।
तं प्रियासं बहु रोचमानो दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय ॥
verses.rom:
somasya parnah saha ugramagann indrena datto varunena shishtah |
tam priyasam bahu rochamano dirghayutvaya shatasharadaya ||
verses.en: The parṇá, Soma's formidable power, hath come, given by Indra, governed (çās) by Varuṇa; may I, shining greatly, wear it in order to length of life for a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
आ मारुक्षत्पर्णमणिर्मह्या अरिष्टतातये ।
यथाहमुत्तरोऽसान्यर्यम्ण उत संविदः ॥
verses.rom:
a marukshatparnamanirmahya arishtatataye |
yathahamuttaro'sanyaryamna uta samvidah ||
verses.en: The parṇá-amulet hath ascended me, in order to great unharmedness, so that I may be superior to patron (aryamán) and to ally (saṁvíd).

verses.sa:
ये धीवानो रथकाराः कर्मारा ये मनीषिणः ।
उपस्तीन् पर्ण मह्यं त्वं सर्वान् कृण्वभितो जनान् ॥
verses.rom:
ye dhivano rathakarah karmara ye manishinah |
upastin parna mahyam tvam sarvan krinvabhito janan ||
verses.en: They that are clever chariot-makers, that are skilful smiths—subjects to me do thou, O parṇá, make all people (jána) round about.

verses.sa:
ये राजानो राजकृतः सूता ग्रामण्यश्च ये ।
उपस्तीन् पर्ण मह्यं त्वं सर्वान् कृण्वभितो जनान् ॥
verses.rom:
ye rajano rajakritah suta gramanyashcha ye |
upastin parna mahyam tvam sarvan krinvabhito janan ||
verses.en: They that are kings, king-makers, that are charioteers and troop-leaders—subjects to me do thou, O parṇá, make all people round about.

verses.sa:
पर्णोऽसि तनूपानः सयोनिर्वीरो वीरेण मया ।
संवत्सरस्य तेजसा तेन बध्नामि त्वा मणे ॥
verses.rom:
parno'si tanupanah sayonirviro virena maya |
samvatsarasya tejasa tena badhnami tva mane ||
verses.en: Parṇá art thou, body-protecting; a hero, from the same womb (yóni) with me a hero; with the year's brilliancy—therewith I bind thee on, O amulet.

verses.sa:
पुमान् पुंसः परिजातोऽश्वत्थः खदिरादधि ।
स हन्तु शत्रून् मामकान् यान् अहं द्वेष्मि ये च माम् ॥
verses.rom:
puman pumsah parijato'shvatthah khadiradadhi |
sa hantu shatrun mamakan yan aham dveshmi ye cha mam ||
verses.en: The male (púmāṅs) [is] born out of the male—the açvatthá forth from the khadirá; let it smite my foes, whom I hate and who [hate] me.

verses.sa:
तान् अश्वत्थ निः शृणीहि शत्रून् वैबाधदोधतः ।
इन्द्रेण वृत्रघ्ना मेदी मित्रेण वरुणेन च ॥
verses.rom:
tan ashvattha nih shrinihi shatrun vaibadhadodhatah |
indrena vritraghna medi mitrena varunena cha ||
verses.en: Crush them out, O açvatthá, our violent foes, O expelling one, allied with Vṛtra-slaying Indra, with Mitra, and with Varuṇa.

verses.sa:
यथाश्वत्थ निरभनोऽन्तर्महत्यर्णवे ।
एवा तान्त्सर्वान् निर्भङ्ग्धि यान् अहं द्वेष्मि ये च माम् ॥
verses.rom:
yathashvattha nirabhano'ntarmahatyarnave |
eva tantsarvan nirbhangdhi yan aham dveshmi ye cha mam ||
verses.en: As thou, O açvatthá, didst break out [the khadirá] within the great sea, so do thou break out all these, whom I hate and who [hate] me.

verses.sa:
यः सहमानश्चरसि सासहान इव ऋषभः ।
तेनाश्वत्थ त्वया वयं सपत्नान्त्सहिषीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
yah sahamanashcharasi sasahana iva rishabhah |
tenashvattha tvaya vayam sapatnantsahishimahi ||
verses.en: Thou that goest about overpowering, like a bull that has overpowered—with thee here, O açvatthá, may we overpower our rivals.

verses.sa:
सिनात्वेनान् निर्ऋतिर्मृत्योः पाशैरमोक्यैः ।
अश्वत्थ शत्रून् मामकान् यान् अहं द्वेष्मि ये च माम् ॥
verses.rom:
sinatvenan nirritirmrityoh pashairamokyaih |
ashvattha shatrun mamakan yan aham dveshmi ye cha mam ||
verses.en: Let perdition bind them, with unreleasable fetters of death—my foes, O açvatthá, whom I hate and who [hate] me.

verses.sa:
यथाश्वत्थ वानस्पत्यान् आरोहन् कृणुषेऽधरान् ।
एवा मे शत्रोर्मूर्धानं विष्वग्भिन्द्धि सहस्व च ॥
verses.rom:
yathashvattha vanaspatyan arohan krinushe'dharan |
eva me shatrormurdhanam vishvagbhinddhi sahasva cha ||
verses.en: As, O açvatthá, ascending them of the forest-trees, thou dost put them beneath thee (ádhara), so the head of my foe do thou split apart and overcome.

verses.sa:
तेऽधराञ्चः प्र प्लवन्तां छिन्ना नौरिव बन्धनात्।
न वैबाधप्रणुत्तानां पुनरस्ति निवर्तनम् ॥
verses.rom:
te'dharanchah pra plavantam chhinna nauriva bandhanat|
na vaibadhapranuttanam punarasti nivartanam ||
verses.en: Let them float forth downward, like a boat severed from its mooring (bándhana); of them, thrust forth by the expelling one, there is no returning again.

verses.sa:
प्रैणान् नुदे मनसा प्र चित्तेनोत ब्रह्मणा ।
प्रैणान् वृक्षस्य शाखयाश्वत्थस्य नुदामहे ॥
verses.rom:
prainan nude manasa pra chittenota brahmana |
prainan vrikshasya shakhayashvatthasya nudamahe ||
verses.en: I thrust them forth with mind, forth with intent and incantation; forth with branch of tree, of açvatthá, we thrust them.

verses.sa:
हरिणस्य रघुष्यदोऽधि शीर्षणि भेषजम् ।
स क्षेत्रियं विषाणया विषूचीनमनीनशत् ॥
verses.rom:
harinasya raghushyado'dhi shirshani bheshajam |
sa kshetriyam vishanaya vishuchinamaninashat ||
verses.en: On the head of the swift-running gazelle (hariṇá) is a remedy; he by his horn hath made the kṣetriyá disappear, dispersing.

verses.sa:
अनु त्वा हरिणो वृषा पद्भिश्चतुर्भिरक्रमीत्।
विषाणे वि ष्य गुष्पितं यदस्य क्षेत्रियं हृदि ॥
verses.rom:
anu tva harino vrisha padbhishchaturbhirakramit|
vishane vi shya gushpitam yadasya kshetriyam hridi ||
verses.en: After thee hath the bull-gazelle stridden with his four feet; O horn, do thou unfasten (vi-sā) the kṣetriyá that is compacted (?) in his heart.

verses.sa:
अदो यदवरोचते चतुष्पक्षमिव छदिः ।
तेना ते सर्वं क्षेत्रियमङ्गेभ्यो नाशयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
ado yadavarochate chatushpakshamiva chhadih |
tena te sarvam kshetriyamangebhyo nashayamasi ||
verses.en: What shines down yonder, like a four-sided roof (chadís), therewith we make all the kṣetriyá disappear from thy limbs.

verses.sa:
अमू ये दिवि सुभगे विचृतौ नाम तारके ।
वि क्षेत्रियस्य मुञ्चतामधमं पाशमुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
amu ye divi subhage vichritau nama tarake |
vi kshetriyasya munchatamadhamam pashamuttamam ||
verses.en: The two blessed stars named Unfasteners (vicṛ́t), that are yonder in the sky—let them unfasten of the kṣetriyá the lowest, the highest fetter.

verses.sa:
आप इद्वा उ भेषजीरापो अमीवचातनीः ।
आपो विश्वस्य भेषजीस्तास्त्वा मुञ्चन्तु क्षेत्रियात् ॥
verses.rom:
apa idva u bheshajirapo amivachatanih |
apo vishvasya bheshajistastva munchantu kshetriyat ||
verses.en: The waters verily [are] remedial, the waters disease-expelling, the waters remedial of everything; let them release thee from kṣetriyá.

verses.sa:
यदासुतेः क्रियमानायाः क्षेत्रियं त्वा व्यानशे ।
वेदाहं तस्य भेषजं क्षेत्रियं नाशयामि त्वत् ॥
verses.rom:
yadasuteh kriyamanayah kshetriyam tva vyanashe |
vedaham tasya bheshajam kshetriyam nashayami tvat ||
verses.en: If from the drink (? āsutí) that was being made the kṣetriyá hath come upon (vi-aç) thee, I know the remedy of it; I make the kṣetriyá disappear from thee.

verses.sa:
अपवासे नक्षत्राणामपवास उषसामुत ।
अपास्मत्सर्वं दुर्भूतमप क्षेत्रियमुच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
apavase nakshatranamapavasa ushasamuta |
apasmatsarvam durbhutamapa kshetriyamuchchhatu ||
verses.en: In the fading-out of the asterisms, in the fading-out of the dawns also, from us [fade] out all that is of evil nature, fade out (apa-vas) the kṣetriyá.

verses.sa:
आ यातु मित्र ऋतुभिः कल्पमानः संवेशयन् पृथिवीमुस्रियाभिः ।
अथास्मभ्यं वरुणो वायुरग्निर्बृहद्राष्ट्रं संवेश्यं दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
a yatu mitra ritubhih kalpamanah samveshayan prithivimusriyabhih |
athasmabhyam varuno vayuragnirbrihadrashtram samveshyam dadhatu ||
verses.en: Let Mitra come, arranging with the seasons, uniting (? sam-veçaya-) the earth with the ruddy ones (usríyā); then to us let Varuṇa, Vāyu, Agni, assign great royalty of union (? saṁveçyà).

verses.sa:
धाता रातिः सवितेदं जुषन्तामिन्द्रस्त्वष्टा प्रति हर्यन्तु मे वचः ।
हुवे देवीमदितिं शूरपुत्रां सजातानां मध्यमेष्ठा यथासानि ॥
verses.rom:
dhata ratih savitedam jushantamindrastvashta prati haryantu me vachah |
huve devimaditim shuraputram sajatanam madhyameshtha yathasani ||
verses.en: Let Dhātar, Rāti, Savitar enjoy here (idám); let Indra, Tvashṭar, welcome my words (vácas); I call the divine Aditi, mother of heroes (çū́ra-), that I may be midmost man of my fellows.

verses.sa:
हुवे सोमं सवितारं नमोभिर्विश्वान् आदित्यामहमुत्तरत्वे ।
अयमग्निर्दीदायद्दीर्घमेव सजातैरिद्धोऽप्रतिब्रुवद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
huve somam savitaram namobhirvishvan adityamahamuttaratve |
ayamagnirdidayaddirghameva sajatairiddho'pratibruvadbhih ||
verses.en: I call, with acts of homage. Soma, Savitar, all the Ādityas, in the contest for preëminence; may this fire shine for very long, kindled by [my] fellows who gainsay not.

verses.sa:
इहेदसाथ न परो गमाथेर्यो गोपाः पुष्टपतिर्व आजत्।
अस्मै कामायोप कामिनीर्विश्वे वो देवा उपसंयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
ihedasatha na paro gamatheryo gopah pushtapatirva ajat|
asmai kamayopa kaminirvishve vo deva upasamyantu ||
verses.en: May ye be just here; may ye not go away (parás); may an active herdsman (gopā́), lord of prosperity, drive you hither; do ye, with [your] desires, [attend] upon (?) his desire; let all the gods conduct you together hither.

verses.sa:
सं वो मनांसि सं व्रता समाकूतीर्नमामसि ।
अमी ये विव्रता स्थन तान् वः सं नमयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
sam vo manamsi sam vrata samakutirnamamasi |
ami ye vivrata sthana tan vah sam namayamasi ||
verses.en: We bend together your minds, together your courses (vratá), together your designs; ye yonder who are of discordant courses, we make you bend [them] together here.

verses.sa:
अहं गृभ्णामि मनसा मनांसि मम चित्तमनु चित्तेभिरेत ।
मम वशेषु हृदयानि वः कृणोमि मम यातमनुवर्त्मान एत ॥
verses.rom:
aham gribhnami manasa manamsi mama chittamanu chittebhireta |
mama vasheshu hridayani vah krinomi mama yatamanuvartmana eta ||
verses.en: I seize [your] minds with [my] mind; come ye after my intent with [your] intents; I put your hearts in my control; come with [your] tracks following my motion (yātá).

verses.sa:
कर्शफस्य विशफस्य द्यौः पिता पृथिवी माता ।
यथाभिचक्र देवास्तथाप कृणुता पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
karshaphasya vishaphasya dyauh pita prithivi mata |
yathabhichakra devastathapa krinuta punah ||

verses.sa:
अश्रेष्माणो अधारयन् तथा तन् मनुना कृतम् ।
कृणोमि वध्रि विष्कन्धं मुष्काबर्हो गवामिव ॥
verses.rom:
ashreshmano adharayan tatha tan manuna kritam |
krinomi vadhri vishkandham mushkabarho gavamiva ||

verses.sa:
पिशङ्गे सूत्रे खृगलं तदा बध्नन्ति वेधसः ।
श्रवस्युं शुष्मं काबवं वध्रिं कृण्वन्तु बन्धुरः ॥
verses.rom:
pishange sutre khrigalam tada badhnanti vedhasah |
shravasyum shushmam kabavam vadhrim krinvantu bandhurah ||

verses.sa:
येना श्रवस्यवश्चरथ देवा इवासुरमायया ।
शुनां कपिरिव दूषणो बन्धुरा काबवस्य च ॥
verses.rom:
yena shravasyavashcharatha deva ivasuramayaya |
shunam kapiriva dushano bandhura kabavasya cha ||

verses.sa:
दुष्ट्यै हि त्वा भत्स्यामि दूषयिष्यामि काबवम् ।
उदाशवो रथा इव शपथेभिः सरिष्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
dushtyai hi tva bhatsyami dushayishyami kabavam |
udashavo ratha iva shapathebhih sarishyatha ||

verses.sa:
एकशतं विष्कन्धानि विष्ठिता पृथिवीमनु ।
तेषां त्वामग्रे उज्जहरुर्मणिं विष्कन्धदूषणम् ॥
verses.rom:
ekashatam vishkandhani vishthita prithivimanu |
tesham tvamagre ujjaharurmanim vishkandhadushanam ||

prose.en:
1. Of the karçápha, of the viçaphá, heaven [is] father, earth mother: as, O gods, ye have inflicted (abhi-kṛ), so do ye remove (apa-kṛ) again.

2. Without claspers they held fast (dhāraya); that was so done by Manu; I make the víṣkandha impotent, like a castrater of bulls.

3. On a reddish string a khṛ́gala—that the pious (vedhás) bind on; let the binders (?) make impotent the flowing (?), puffing (?) kābavá.

5. Wherewith, O flowing ones, ye go about (car), like gods with Asura-magic (-māyā), like the ape, spoiler of dogs, and with the binder (?) of the kābavá.

6. A hundred and one víṣkandhas [are] distributed over the earth; thee have they first taken up, of them the víṣkandha-spoiling amulet.

verses.sa:
प्रथमा ह व्युवास सा धेनुरभवद्यमे ।
सा नः पयस्वती दुहामुत्तरामुत्तरां समाम् ॥
verses.rom:
prathama ha vyuvasa sa dhenurabhavadyame |
sa nah payasvati duhamuttaramuttaram samam ||
verses.en: She first shone out; she became a milch-cow at Yama's; let her, rich in milk, yield (duh) to us each further summer (? sámā).

verses.sa:
यां देवाः प्रतिनन्दन्ति रात्रिं धेनुमुपायतीम् ।
संवत्सरस्य या पत्नी सा नो अस्तु सुमङ्गली ॥
verses.rom:
yam devah pratinandanti ratrim dhenumupayatim |
samvatsarasya ya patni sa no astu sumangali ||
verses.en: The night which the gods rejoice to meet, [as] a milch-cow coming unto [them], which is the spouse (pátnī) of the year—let her be very auspicious to us.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरस्य प्रतिमां यां त्वा रात्र्युपास्महे ।
सा न आयुष्मतीं प्रजां रायस्पोषेण सं सृज ॥
verses.rom:
samvatsarasya pratimam yam tva ratryupasmahe |
sa na ayushmatim prajam rayasposhena sam srija ||
verses.en: Thou, O night, whom we worship (upa-ās) as model (pratimā́) of the year-—do thou unite our long-lived progeny with abundance of wealth.

verses.sa:
इयमेव सा या प्रथमा व्यौच्छदास्वितरासु चरति प्रविष्टा ।
महान्तो अस्यां महिमानो अन्तर्वधूर्जिगाय नवगज्जनित्री ॥
verses.rom:
iyameva sa ya prathama vyauchchhadasvitarasu charati pravishta |
mahanto asyam mahimano antarvadhurjigaya navagajjanitri ||
verses.en: This same is she that first shone out; among these other ones (f.) she goes about (car), having entered; great greatnesses [are] within her; the bride (vadhū́), the new-going generatrix, hath conquered.

verses.sa:
वानस्पत्या ग्रावाणो घोषमक्रत हविष्कृण्वन्तः परिवत्सरीणम् ।
एकाष्टके सुप्रजसः सुवीरा वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspatya gravano ghoshamakrata havishkrinvantah parivatsarinam |
ekashtake suprajasah suvira vayam syama patayo rayinam ||
verses.en: The forest-tree pressing-stones have made their sound, making the oblation of the complete year (parivatsarī́ṇa); O sole áṣṭakā, may we, having good progeny and good heroes, be lords of wealths.

verses.sa:
इडायास्पदं घृतवत्सरीसृपं जातवेदः प्रति हव्या गृभाय ।
ये ग्राम्याः पशवो विश्वरूपास्तेषां सप्तानां मयि रन्तिरस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
idayaspadam ghritavatsarisripam jatavedah prati havya gribhaya |
ye gramyah pashavo vishvarupastesham saptanam mayi rantirastu ||
verses.en: The track (padá) of Idā [is] full of ghee, greatly trickling; O Jātavedas, accept thou the oblations. The cattle of the village that are of all forms—of those seven let the willing stay (ráṁti) be with me.

verses.sa:
आ मा पुष्टे च पोषे च रात्रि देवानां सुमतौ स्याम ।
पूर्णा दर्वे परा पत सुपूर्णा पुनरा पत ।
सर्वान् यज्ञान्त्संभुञ्जतीषमूर्जं न आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
a ma pushte cha poshe cha ratri devanam sumatau syama |
purna darve para pata supurna punara pata |
sarvan yajnantsambhunjatishamurjam na a bhara ||
verses.en: [Set] thou me in both prosperity and abundance; O night, may we be in the favor of the gods.

verses.sa:
आयमगन्त्संवत्सरः पतिरेकाष्टके तव ।
सा न आयुष्मतीं प्रजां रायस्पोषेण सं सृज ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagantsamvatsarah patirekashtake tava |
sa na ayushmatim prajam rayasposhena sam srija ||
verses.en: Hither hath come the year, thy spouse, O sole áṣṭakā; do thou unite our long-lived progeny with abundance of wealth.

verses.sa:
ऋतून् यज ऋतुपतीन् आर्तवान् उत हायनान् ।
समाः संवत्सरान् मासान् भूतस्य पतये यजे ॥
verses.rom:
ritun yaja ritupatin artavan uta hayanan |
samah samvatsaran masan bhutasya pataye yaje ||
verses.en: I sacrifice to the seasons, the lords of the seasons, them of the seasons (ārtavá), and the winters (hāyaná), to the summers (sámā), the years, the months; for the lord of existence I sacrifice.

verses.sa:
ऋतुभ्यष्ट्वार्तवेभ्यो माद्भ्यः संवत्सरेभ्यः ।
धात्रे विधात्रे समृधे भूतस्य पतये यजे ॥
verses.rom:
ritubhyashtvartavebhyo madbhyah samvatsarebhyah |
dhatre vidhatre samridhe bhutasya pataye yaje ||
verses.en: To thee for the seasons, them of the seasons, the months, the years, the Creator (dhātár), the Disposer (vidhātár), the Prosperer (? samṛ́dh), the lord of existence, do I sacrifice.

verses.sa:
इडया जुह्वतो वयं देवान् घृतवता यजे ।
गृहान् अलुभ्यतो वयं सं विशेमोप गोमतः ॥
verses.rom:
idaya juhvato vayam devan ghritavata yaje |
grihan alubhyato vayam sam vishemopa gomatah ||
verses.en: We, making oblation with ídā—I sacrifice to the gods with what is rich in ghee; unto houses not disorderly (? álubhyant), rich in kine, may we enter together.

verses.sa:
एकाष्टका तपसा तप्यमाना जजान गर्भं महिमानमिन्द्रम् ।
तेन देवा व्यसहन्त शत्रून् हन्ता दस्यूनामभवच्छचीपतिः ॥
verses.rom:
ekashtaka tapasa tapyamana jajana garbham mahimanamindram |
tena deva vyasahanta shatrun hanta dasyunamabhavachchhachipatih ||
verses.en: The sole áṣṭakā, paining herself (tapyá-) with penance, generated an embryo, a greatness, Indra; by him the gods overcame their foes; slayer of the barbarians became the lord of might (çácī-).

verses.sa:
इन्द्रपुत्रे सोमपुत्रे दुहितासि प्रजापतेः ।
कामान् अस्माकं पूरय प्रति गृह्णाहि नो हविः ॥
verses.rom:
indraputre somaputre duhitasi prajapateh |
kaman asmakam puraya prati grihnahi no havih ||
verses.en: Thou whose son is Indra, whose son is Soma, daughter art thou of Prajāpati; fulfil thou our desires; accept our oblation.

verses.sa:
मुञ्चामि त्वा हविषा जीवनाय कमज्ञातयक्ष्मादुत राजयक्ष्मात्।
ग्राहिर्जग्राह यद्येतदेनं तस्या इन्द्राग्नी प्र मुमुक्तमेनम् ॥
verses.rom:
munchami tva havisha jivanaya kamajnatayakshmaduta rajayakshmat|
grahirjagraha yadyetadenam tasya indragni pra mumuktamenam ||
verses.en: I release thee by oblation, in order to living, from unknown yákṣma and from royal yákṣma; if now seizure (gráhi) hath seized him, from it, O Indra-and-Agni, do ye release him.

verses.sa:
यदि क्षितायुर्यदि वा परेतो यदि मृत्योरन्तिकमेव ।
तमा हरामि निर्ऋतेरुपस्थादस्पार्शमेनं शतशारदाय ॥
verses.rom:
yadi kshitayuryadi va pareto yadi mrityorantikameva |
tama harami nirriterupasthadasparshamenam shatasharadaya ||
verses.en: If of exhausted life-time, or if deceased, if gone down even to the presence (antiká) of death, him I take from the lap of perdition; I have won (spṛ) him for [life] of a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
सहस्राक्षेण शतवीर्येण शतायुषा हविषाहार्षमेनम् ।
इन्द्रो यथैनं शरदो नयात्यति विश्वस्य दुरितस्य पारम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrakshena shataviryena shatayusha havishaharshamenam |
indro yathainam sharado nayatyati vishvasya duritasya param ||
verses.en: With an oblation having a thousand eyes, a hundred heroisms, a hundred life-times, have I taken him, in order that Indra may lead him unto autumns, across to the further shore of all difficulty (duritá).

verses.sa:
शतं जीव शरदो वर्धमानः शतं हेमन्तान् छतमु वसन्तान् ।
शतं ते इन्द्रो अग्निः सविता बृहस्पतिः शतायुषा हविषाहार्षमेनम् ॥
verses.rom:
shatam jiva sharado vardhamanah shatam hemantan chhatamu vasantan |
shatam te indro agnih savita brihaspatih shatayusha havishaharshamenam ||
verses.en: Live thou increasing a hundred autumns, a hundred winters, and a

verses.sa:
प्र विशतं प्राणापानावनड्वाहाविव व्रजम् ।
व्यन्ये यन्तु मृत्यवो यान् आहुरितरान् छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vishatam pranapanavanadvahaviva vrajam |
vyanye yantu mrityavo yan ahuritaran chhatam ||
verses.en: Enter in, O breath-and-expiration, as two draft-oxen a pen (vrajá); let the other deaths go away (ví), which they call the remaining hundred.

verses.sa:
इहैव स्तं प्राणापानौ माप गातमितो युवम् ।
शरीरमस्याङ्गानि जरसे वहतं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
ihaiva stam pranapanau mapa gatamito yuvam |
shariramasyangani jarase vahatam punah ||
verses.en: Be ye just here, O breath-and-expiration; go ye not away from here; carry his body, his limbs, unto old age again.

verses.sa:
जरायै त्वा परि ददामि जरायै नि धुवामि त्वा ।
जरा त्वा भद्रा नेष्ट व्यन्ये यन्तु मृत्यवो यान् आहुरितरान् छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
jarayai tva pari dadami jarayai ni dhuvami tva |
jara tva bhadra neshta vyanye yantu mrityavo yan ahuritaran chhatam ||
verses.en: Unto old age do I commit thee; unto old age do I shake thee down (ni-dhū); may old age, excellent, conduct thee; let the other deaths go away, which they call the remaining hundred.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा जरिमाहित गामुक्षणमिव रज्ज्वा ।
यस्त्वा मृत्युरभ्यधत्त जायमानं सुपाशया ।
तं ते सत्यस्य हस्ताभ्यामुदमुञ्चद्बृहस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva jarimahita gamukshanamiva rajjva |
yastva mrityurabhyadhatta jayamanam supashaya |
tam te satyasya hastabhyamudamunchadbrihaspatih ||
verses.en: Old age hath curbed (abhi-dhā) thee, as it were a cow, an ox, with a rope; the death that curbed thee, when born, with easy fetter—that Brihaspati released for thee, with the (two) hands of truth.

verses.sa:
इहैव ध्रुवां नि मिनोमि शालां क्षेमे तिष्ठाति घृतमुक्षमाणा ।
तां त्वा शाले सर्ववीराः सुवीरा अरिष्टवीरा उप सं चरेम ॥
verses.rom:
ihaiva dhruvam ni minomi shalam ksheme tishthati ghritamukshamana |
tam tva shale sarvavirah suvira arishtavira upa sam charema ||
verses.en: Just here I fix (ni-mi) [my] dwelling (çā́lā) firm; may it stand in security, sprinkling ghee; unto thee here, O dwelling, may we resort (sam-car) with all our heroes, with good heroes, with unharmed heroes.

verses.sa:
इहैव ध्रुवा प्रति तिष्ठ शालेऽश्वावती गोमती सूनृतावती ।
ऊर्जस्वती घृतवती पयस्वत्युच्छ्रयस्व महते सौभगाय ॥
verses.rom:
ihaiva dhruva prati tishtha shale'shvavati gomati sunritavati |
urjasvati ghritavati payasvatyuchchhrayasva mahate saubhagaya ||
verses.en: Just here stand thou firm, O dwelling, rich in horses, in kine, in pleasantness, in refreshment, in ghee, in milk; erect thyself (ut-çri) in order to great good-fortune.

verses.sa:
धरुण्यसि शाले बृहच्छन्दाः पूतिधान्या ।
आ त्वा वत्सो गमेदा कुमार आ धेनवः सायमास्पन्दमानाः ॥
verses.rom:
dharunyasi shale brihachchhandah putidhanya |
a tva vatso gameda kumara a dhenavah sayamaspandamanah ||
verses.en: A garner (? dharunī́) art thou, O dwelling, of great roof, of cleansed grain; to thee may the calf come, may the boy, may the kine, streaming in at evening.

verses.sa:
इमां शालां सविता वायुरिन्द्रो बृहस्पतिर्नि मिनोतु प्रजानन् ।
उक्षन्तूद्ना मरुतो घृतेन भगो नो राजा नि कृषिं तनोतु ॥
verses.rom:
imam shalam savita vayurindro brihaspatirni minotu prajanan |
ukshantudna maruto ghritena bhago no raja ni krishim tanotu ||
verses.en: This dwelling let Savitar, Vayu, Indra, Brihaspati fix, foreknowing; let the Maruts sprinkle it with water, with ghee; let king Bhaga deepen (ni-tan) our ploughing.

verses.sa:
मानस्य पत्नि शरणा स्योना देवी देवेभिर्निमितास्यग्रे ।
तृणं वसाना सुमना असस्त्वमथास्मभ्यं सहवीरं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
manasya patni sharana syona devi devebhirnimitasyagre |
trinam vasana sumana asastvamathasmabhyam sahaviram rayim dah ||
verses.en: O mistress of the building (? mā́na), as sheltering, pleasant, hast thou, a goddess, been fixed by the gods in the beginning; clothing thyself in grass, mayest thou be well-willing; then mayest thou give us wealth together with heroes.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन स्थूणामधि रोह वंशोग्रो विराजन्न् अप वृङ्क्ष्व शत्रून् ।
मा ते रिषन्न् उपसत्तारो गृहाणां शाले शतं जीवेम शरदः सर्ववीराः ॥
verses.rom:
ritena sthunamadhi roha vamshogro virajann apa vrinkshva shatrun |
ma te rishann upasattaro grihanam shale shatam jivema sharadah sarvavirah ||
verses.en: With due order, O beam (vaṅçá), ascend the post; formidable, bearing rule, force away (apa-vṛj) the foes; let not the attendants (upasattár) of thy houses be harmed, O dwelling; may we live a hundred autumns with all our heroes.

verses.sa:
एमां कुमारस्तरुण आ वत्सो जगता सह ।
एमां परिस्रुतः कुम्भ आ दध्नः कलशैरगुः ॥
verses.rom:
emam kumarastaruna a vatso jagata saha |
emam parisrutah kumbha a dadhnah kalashairaguh ||
verses.en: To it the tender boy, to it the calf, with moving creatures (jágat), to it the jar of parisrút, with mugs of curd, have come.

verses.sa:
पूर्णं नारि प्र भर कुम्भमेतं घृतस्य धाराममृतेन संभृताम् ।
इमां पातॄन् अमृतेन समङ्ग्धीष्टापूर्तमभि रक्षात्येनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
purnam nari pra bhara kumbhametam ghritasya dharamamritena sambhritam |
imam patrin amritena samangdhishtapurtamabhi rakshatyenam ||
verses.en: Bring forward, O woman, this full jar, a stream of ghee combined (sam-bhṛ) with ambrosia (amṛ́ta); anoint these drinkers (?) with ambrosia; let what is offered-and-bestowed defend it (f.: the dwelling?).

verses.sa:
इमा आपः प्र भराम्ययक्ष्मा यक्ष्मनाशनीः ।
गृहान् उप प्र सीदाम्यमृतेन सहाग्निना ॥
verses.rom:
ima apah pra bharamyayakshma yakshmanashanih |
grihan upa pra sidamyamritena sahagnina ||
verses.en: These waters I bring forward, free from yákṣma, yákṣma-effacing; I set forth (? pra-sad) unto (úpa) the houses, along with immortal (amṛ́ta) fire.

verses.sa:
यददः संप्रयतीरहावनदता हते ।
तस्मादा नद्यो नाम स्थ ता वो नामानि सिन्धवः ॥
verses.rom:
yadadah samprayatirahavanadata hate |
tasmada nadyo nama stha ta vo namani sindhavah ||
verses.en: Since formerly (? adás), going forth together, ye resounded (nad) when the dragon was slain, thenceforth ye are streams (nadī́) by name: these are your names, O rivers.

verses.sa:
यत्प्रेषिता वरुणेनाच्छीभं समवल्गत ।
तदाप्नोदिन्द्रो वो यतीस्तस्मादापो अनु ष्ठन ॥
verses.rom:
yatpreshita varunenachchhibham samavalgata |
tadapnodindro vo yatistasmadapo anu shthana ||
verses.en: When, sent forth by Varuna, ye thereupon (ā́t) quickly skipped (valg) together, then Indra obtained (āp) you as ye went; therefore are ye waters (ā́p) afterward.

verses.sa:
अपकामं स्यन्दमाना अवीवरत वो हि कम् ।
इन्द्रो वः शक्तिभिर्देवीस्तस्माद्वार्नाम वो हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
apakamam syandamana avivarata vo hi kam |
indro vah shaktibhirdevistasmadvarnama vo hitam ||
verses.en: As ye were flowing perversely (apakāmám), since Indra verily hindered (var) you by his powers, you, ye divine ones, therefore the name water (vā́r) is assigned you.

verses.sa:
एकः वो देवोऽप्यतिष्ठत्स्यन्दमाना यथावशम् ।
उदानिषुर्महीरिति तस्मादुदकमुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
ekah vo devo'pyatishthatsyandamana yathavasham |
udanishurmahiriti tasmadudakamuchyate ||
verses.en: The one god stood up to you, flowing at [your] will; "the great ones have breathed up (ud-an)," said he; therefore water (udaká) is [so] called.

verses.sa:
आपो भद्रा घृतमिदाप आसन्न् अग्नीषोमौ बिभ्रत्याप इत्ताः ।
तीव्रो रसो मधुपृचामरंगम आ मा प्राणेन सह वर्चसा गमेत् ॥
verses.rom:
apo bhadra ghritamidapa asann agnishomau bibhratyapa ittah |
tivro raso madhuprichamaramgama a ma pranena saha varchasa gamet ||
verses.en: The waters [are] excellent; the waters verily were ghee; these waters verily bear Agni-and-Soma; may the strong (tīvrá) satisfying savor (rása) of the honey-mixed (-pṛc) come to me along with breath, with splendor.

verses.sa:
आदित्पश्याम्युत वा शृणोम्या मा घोषो गच्छति वाङ्मासाम् ।
मन्ये भेजानो अमृतस्य तर्हि हिरण्यवर्णा अतृपं यदा वः ॥
verses.rom:
aditpashyamyuta va shrinomya ma ghosho gachchhati vanmasam |
manye bhejano amritasya tarhi hiranyavarna atripam yada vah ||
verses.en: Then indeed I see, or also hear; unto me comes the noise, to me the voice of them; I think myself then to have partaken ambrosia (amṛ́ta) when, ye gold-colored ones, I have enjoyed (tṛp) you.

verses.sa:
इदं व आपो हृदयमयं वत्स ऋतावरीः ।
इहेत्थमेत शक्वरीर्यत्रेदं वेशयामि वः ॥
verses.rom:
idam va apo hridayamayam vatsa ritavarih |
ihetthameta shakvariryatredam veshayami vah ||
verses.en: This, O waters, [is] your heart, this your young (vatsá), ye righteous ones; come thus hither, ye mighty ones, where I now make you enter.

verses.sa:
सं वो गोष्ठेन सुषदा सं रय्या सं सुभूत्या ।
अहर्जातस्य यन् नाम तेना वः सं सृजामसि ॥
verses.rom:
sam vo goshthena sushada sam rayya sam subhutya |
aharjatasya yan nama tena vah sam srijamasi ||
verses.en: With a comfortable (suṣád) stall, with wealth, with well-being, with that which is the name of the day-born one, do we unite you.

verses.sa:
सं वः सृजत्वर्यमा सं पूषा सं बृहस्पतिः ।
समिन्द्रो यो धनंजयो मयि पुष्यत यद्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
sam vah srijatvaryama sam pusha sam brihaspatih |
samindro yo dhanamjayo mayi pushyata yadvasu ||
verses.en: Let Aryaman unite you, let Pūshan, let Brihaspati, let Indra, who is conqueror of riches; in my possession gain ye what is good.

verses.sa:
संजग्माना अबिभ्युषीरस्मिन् गोष्ठे करीषिणीः ।
बिभ्रतीः सोम्यं मध्वनमीवा उपेतन ॥
verses.rom:
samjagmana abibhyushirasmin goshthe karishinih |
bibhratih somyam madhvanamiva upetana ||
verses.en: Having come together, iinaffrighted, rich in manure, in this stall, bearing the sweet of soma, come ye hither, free from disease.

verses.sa:
इहैव गाव एतनेहो शकेव पुष्यत ।
इहैवोत प्र जायध्वं मयि संज्ञानमस्तु वः ॥
verses.rom:
ihaiva gava etaneho shakeva pushyata |
ihaivota pra jayadhvam mayi samjnanamastu vah ||
verses.en: Come ye just here, O kine, and flourish here like çákā; also multiply (pra-jā) just here; let your complaisance be toward me.

verses.sa:
शिवो वो गोष्ठो भवतु शारिशाकेव पुष्यत ।
इहैवोत प्र जायध्वं मया वः सं सृजामसि ॥
verses.rom:
shivo vo goshtho bhavatu sharishakeva pushyata |
ihaivota pra jayadhvam maya vah sam srijamasi ||
verses.en: Let your stall be propitious; flourish ye like çāriçā́kā; also multiply just here; with me we unite you.

verses.sa:
मया गावो गोपतिना सचध्वमयं वो गोष्ठ इह पोषयिष्णुः ।
रायस्पोषेण बहुला भवन्तीर्जीवा जीवन्तीरुप वः सदेम ॥
verses.rom:
maya gavo gopatina sachadhvamayam vo goshtha iha poshayishnuh |
rayasposhena bahula bhavantirjiva jivantirupa vah sadema ||
verses.en: Attach yourselves, O kine, to me as lord of kine; this your stall here [be] flourishing; to you, becoming numerous with abundance of wealth, to you living, may we living be near (upa-sad).

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमहं वणिजं चोदयामि स न ऐतु पुरएता नो अस्तु ।
नुदन्न् अरातिं परिपन्थिनं मृगं स ईशानो धनदा अस्तु मह्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
indramaham vanijam chodayami sa na aitu puraeta no astu |
nudann aratim paripanthinam mrigam sa ishano dhanada astu mahyam ||
verses.en: I stir up (cud) the trader Indra; let him come to us, be our forerunner; thrusting [away] the niggard, the waylaying wild animal, let him, having the power (īç), be giver of riches to me.

verses.sa:
ये पन्थानो बहवो देवयाना अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी संचरन्ति ।
ते मा जुषन्तां पयसा घृतेन यथा क्रीत्वा धनमाहराणि ॥
verses.rom:
ye panthano bahavo devayana antara dyavaprithivi samcharanti |
te ma jushantam payasa ghritena yatha kritva dhanamaharani ||
verses.en: The many roads, travelled by the gods, that go about (sam-car) between heaven-and-earth—let them enjoy me with milk, with ghee, that dealing (krī) I may get (ā-hṛ) riches.

verses.sa:
इध्मेनाग्न इच्छमानो घृतेन जुहोमि हव्यं तरसे बलाय ।
यावदीशे ब्रह्मणा वन्दमान इमां धियं शतसेयाय देवीम् ॥
verses.rom:
idhmenagna ichchhamano ghritena juhomi havyam tarase balaya |
yavadishe brahmana vandamana imam dhiyam shataseyaya devim ||
verses.en: With fuel, O Agni, with ghee, I, desiring, offer the oblation, in order to energy (táras), to strength;—revering with worship (bráhman), so far as I am able—this divine prayer (dhī́), in order to hundred-fold winning.

verses.sa:
इमामग्ने शरणिं मीमृषो नो यमध्वानमगाम दूरम् ।
शुनं नो अस्तु प्रपणो विक्रयश्च प्रतिपणः फलिनं मा कृणोतु ।
इदं हव्यं संविदानौ जुषेथां शुनं नो अस्तु चरितमुत्थितं च ॥
verses.rom:
imamagne sharanim mimrisho no yamadhvanamagama duram |
shunam no astu prapano vikrayashcha pratipanah phalinam ma krinotu |
idam havyam samvidanau jushetham shunam no astu charitamutthitam cha ||
verses.en: This offense (? çaráṇi) of ours mayest thou, O Agni, bear with (mṛṣ), what distant road we have gone. Successful (çuná) for us be bargain and sale; let return-dealing make me fruitful; do ye two enjoy this oblation in concord; successful for us be our going about and rising.

verses.sa:
येन धनेन प्रपणं चरामि धनेन देवा धनमिच्छमानः ।
तन् मे भूयो भवतु मा कनीयोऽग्ने सातघ्नो देवान् हविषा नि षेध ॥
verses.rom:
yena dhanena prapanam charami dhanena deva dhanamichchhamanah |
tan me bhuyo bhavatu ma kaniyo'gne sataghno devan havisha ni shedha ||
verses.en: With what riches I practise (car) bargaining, seeking riches with riches, ye gods—let that become more for me, not less; O Agni, put down (ni-sidh) with the oblation the gain-slaying gods.

verses.sa:
येन धनेन प्रपणं चरामि धनेन देवा धनमिच्छमानः ।
तस्मिन् म इन्द्रो रुचिमा दधातु प्रजापतिः सविता सोमो अग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
yena dhanena prapanam charami dhanena deva dhanamichchhamanah |
tasmin ma indro ruchima dadhatu prajapatih savita somo agnih ||
verses.en: With what riches I practise bargaining, seeking riches with riches, ye gods—therein let Indra assign me pleasure (? rúci), let Prajāpati, Savitar, Soma, Agni.

verses.sa:
उप त्वा नमसा वयं होतर्वैश्वानर स्तुमः ।
स नः प्रजास्वात्मसु गोषु प्राणेषु जागृहि ॥
verses.rom:
upa tva namasa vayam hotarvaishvanara stumah |
sa nah prajasvatmasu goshu praneshu jagrihi ||
verses.en: Unto thee with homage do we, O priest Vāiçvānara ('for all men'), give praise; do thou watch over our progeny, our selves, our kine, our breaths.

verses.sa:
विश्वाहा ते सदमिद्भरेमाश्वायेव तिष्ठते जातवेदः ।
रायस्पोषेण समिषा मदन्तो मा ते अग्ने प्रतिवेशा रिषाम ॥
verses.rom:
vishvaha te sadamidbharemashvayeva tishthate jatavedah |
rayasposhena samisha madanto ma te agne prativesha rishama ||
verses.en: Every day may we bring constantly for thee as for a standing horse, O Jātavedas; rejoicing together with abundance of wealth, with food, may we thy neighbors, O Agni, take no harm.

verses.sa:
प्रातरग्निं प्रातरिन्द्रं हवामहे प्रातर्मित्रावरुणा प्रातरश्विना ।
प्रातर्भगं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं प्रातः सोममुत रुद्रं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
prataragnim pratarindram havamahe pratarmitravaruna pratarashvina |
pratarbhagam pushanam brahmanaspatim pratah somamuta rudram havamahe ||
verses.en: Early (prātár) do we call Agni, early Indra, early Mitra-and-Varuṇa, early the (two) Açvins, early Bhaga, Pūshan, Brahmaṇaspati, early Soma and Rudra do we call.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्जितं भगमुग्रं हवामहे वयं पुत्रमदितेर्यो विधर्ता ।
आध्रश्चिद्यं मन्यमानस्तुरश्चिद्राजा चिद्यं भगं भक्षीत्याह ॥
verses.rom:
pratarjitam bhagamugram havamahe vayam putramaditeryo vidharta |
adhrashchidyam manyamanasturashchidraja chidyam bhagam bhakshityaha ||
verses.en: The early-conquering formidable Bhaga do we call, the son of Aditi who is disposer (vidhartár), to whom every one that thinks himself weak [or] strong, to whom even the king says: "apportion [me] a portion."

verses.sa:
भग प्रणेतर्भग सत्यराधो भगेमां धियमुदवा ददन् नः ।
भग प्र णो जनय गोभिरश्वैर्भग प्र नृभिर्नृवन्तः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
bhaga pranetarbhaga satyaradho bhagemam dhiyamudava dadan nah |
bhaga pra no janaya gobhirashvairbhaga pra nribhirnrivantah syama ||
verses.en: O Bhaga, conductor, Bhaga, thou of true bestowal, Bhaga, help upward this prayer (dhī́), giving to us; O Bhaga, cause us to multiply with kine, with horses, O Bhaga, with men,—rich in men may we be.

verses.sa:
उतेदानीं भगवन्तः स्यामोत प्रपित्व उत मध्ये अह्नाम् ।
उतोदितौ मघवन्त्सूर्यस्य वयं देवानां सुमतौ स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
utedanim bhagavantah syamota prapitva uta madhye ahnam |
utoditau maghavantsuryasya vayam devanam sumatau syama ||
verses.en: Both now may we be fortunate (bhágavant), and in the advance (? prapitvá) and in the middle of the days; and, O bounteous one, at the up-going of the sun, may we be in the favor of the gods.

verses.sa:
भग एव भगवाँ अस्तु देवस्तेना वयं भगवन्तः स्याम ।
तं त्वा भग सर्व इज्जोहवीमि स नो भग पुरएता भवेह ॥
verses.rom:
bhaga eva bhagavan astu devastena vayam bhagavantah syama |
tam tva bhaga sarva ijjohavimi sa no bhaga puraeta bhaveha ||
verses.en: Let the god Bhaga himself be fortunate; through him may we be fortunate; on thee here, Bhaga, do I call entire; do thou, O Bhaga, be our forerunner here.

verses.sa:
समध्वरायोषसो नमन्त दधिक्रावेव शुचये पदाय ।
अर्वाचीनं वसुविदं भगं मे रथमिवाश्वा वाजिन आ वहन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
samadhvarayoshaso namanta dadhikraveva shuchaye padaya |
arvachinam vasuvidam bhagam me rathamivashva vajina a vahantu ||
verses.en: The dawns submit themselves (? sam-nam) to the sacrifice (adhvará), as Dadhikrāvan to the bright place; hitherward let them convey for me Bhaga, acquirer of good things, as vigorous (vājín) horses a chariot.

verses.sa:
अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्न उषासो वीरवतीः सदमुच्छन्तु भद्राः ।
घृतं दुहाना विश्वतः प्रपीता यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvavatirgomatirna ushaso viravatih sadamuchchhantu bhadrah |
ghritam duhana vishvatah prapita yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en: Let excellent dawns, rich in horses, rich in kine, rich in heroes, always shine for us, yielding (duh) ghee, on all sides drunk of: do ye protect us ever with well-beings.

verses.sa:
सीरा युञ्जन्ति कवयो युगा वि तन्वते पृथक्।
धीरा देवेषु सुम्नयौ ॥
verses.rom:
sira yunjanti kavayo yuga vi tanvate prithak|
dhira deveshu sumnayau ||
verses.en: The poets (kaví) harness the plows (sī́ra), they extend severally the yokes—they the wise ones (dhī́ra), with desire of favor (?) toward the gods.

verses.sa:
युनक्त सीरा वि युगा तनोत कृते योनौ वपतेह बीजम् ।
विराजः श्नुष्टिः सभरा असन् नो नेदीय इत्सृण्यः पक्वमा यवन् ॥
verses.rom:
yunakta sira vi yuga tanota krite yonau vapateha bijam |
virajah shnushtih sabhara asan no nediya itsrinyah pakvama yavan ||
verses.en: Harness ye the plows, extend the yokes; scatter (vap) the seed here in the prepared womb; may the bunch (?) of virā́j be burdened for us; may the sickles draw in (ā-yu) the ripe [grain] yet closer.

verses.sa:
लाङ्गलं पवीरवत्सुशीमं सोमसत्सरु ।
उदिद्वपतु गामविं प्रस्थावद्रथवाहनं पीबरीं च प्रफर्व्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
langalam paviravatsushimam somasatsaru |
udidvapatu gamavim prasthavadrathavahanam pibarim cha prapharvyam ||
verses.en: Let the plow (lā́n̄gala), lance-pointed, well-lying, with well-smoothed handle, turn up (ud-vap) cow, sheep, an on-going chariot-frame, and a plump wench.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सीतां नि गृह्णातु तां पूषाभि रक्षतु ।
सा नः पयस्वती दुहामुत्तरामुत्तरां समाम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrah sitam ni grihnatu tam pushabhi rakshatu |
sa nah payasvati duhamuttaramuttaram samam ||
verses.en: Let Indra hold down the furrow; let Pūshan defend it; let it, rich in milk, yield to us each further summer.

verses.sa:
शुनं सुफाला वि तुदन्तु भूमिं शुनं कीनाशा अनु यन्तु वाहान् ।
शुनासीरा हविषा तोशमाना सुपिप्पला ओषधीः कर्तमस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
shunam suphala vi tudantu bhumim shunam kinasha anu yantu vahan |
shunasira havisha toshamana supippala oshadhih kartamasmai ||
verses.en: Successfully (çunám) let the good plowshares thrust apart the earth; successfully let the plowmen follow the beasts of draft; O Çunāsīrā, do ye (two), dripping (?) with oblation, make the herbs rich in berries for this man.

verses.sa:
शुनं वाहाः शुनं नरः शुनं कृषतु लाङ्गलम् ।
शुनं वरत्रा बध्यन्तां शुनमष्ट्रामुदिङ्गय ॥
verses.rom:
shunam vahah shunam narah shunam krishatu langalam |
shunam varatra badhyantam shunamashtramudingaya ||
verses.en: Successfully let the draft-animals, successfully the men, successfully let the plow (lā́n̄gala) plow; successfully let the straps be bound; successfully do thou brandish the goad.

verses.sa:
शुनासीरेह स्म मे जुषेथाम् ।
यद्दिवि चक्रथुः पयस्तेनेमामुप सिञ्चतम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunasireha sma me jushetham |
yaddivi chakrathuh payastenemamupa sinchatam ||
verses.en: O Çunāsīrā, do ye (two) enjoy me here; what milk ye have made in heaven, therewith pour ye upon this [furrow].

verses.sa:
सीते वन्दामहे त्वार्वाची सुभगे भव ।
यथा नः सुमना असो यथा नः सुफला भुवः ॥
verses.rom:
site vandamahe tvarvachi subhage bhava |
yatha nah sumana aso yatha nah suphala bhuvah ||
verses.en: O furrow, we reverence thee; be [turned] hitherward, O fortunate one, that thou mayest be well-willing to us, that thou mayest become of good fruit for us.

verses.sa:
घृतेन सीता मधुना समक्ता विश्वैर्देवैरनुमता मरुद्भिः ।
सा नः सीते पयसाभ्याववृत्स्वोर्जस्वती घृतवत्पिन्वमाना ॥
verses.rom:
ghritena sita madhuna samakta vishvairdevairanumata marudbhih |
sa nah site payasabhyavavritsvorjasvati ghritavatpinvamana ||
verses.en: With ghee, with honey (mádhu) [is] the furrow all anointed, approved (anu-man) by all the gods, by the Maruts; do thou, O furrow, turn hither unto us with milk, rich in refreshment, swelling with fulness of ghee.

verses.sa:
इमां खनाम्योषधिं वीरुधां बलवत्तमाम् ।
यया सपत्नीं बाधते यया संविन्दते पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
imam khanamyoshadhim virudham balavattamam |
yaya sapatnim badhate yaya samvindate patim ||
verses.en: I dig this herb, of plants the strongest, with which one drives off (bādh) her rival; with which one wins completely (sam-vid) her husband.

verses.sa:
उत्तानपर्णे सुभगे देवजूते सहस्वति ।
सपत्नीं मे परा णुद पतिं मे केवलं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
uttanaparne subhage devajute sahasvati |
sapatnim me para nuda patim me kevalam kridhi ||
verses.en: O thou of outstretched leaves, fortunate, god-quickened, powerful, do thou thrust away my rival, make my husband wholly mine.

verses.sa:
नहि ते नाम जग्राह नो अस्मिन् रमसे पतौ ।
परामेव परावतं सपत्नीं गमयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
nahi te nama jagraha no asmin ramase patau |
parameva paravatam sapatnim gamayamasi ||
verses.en: Since he has not named (grah) thy name, thou also stayest (ram) not with him as husband; unto distant distance make we my rival go.

verses.sa:
उत्तराहमुत्तर उत्तरेदुत्तराभ्यः ।
अधः सपत्नी या ममाधरा साधराभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
uttarahamuttara uttareduttarabhyah |
adhah sapatni ya mamadhara sadharabhyah ||
verses.en: Superior [am] I, O superior one; superior, indeed, to them (f.) that are superior; below [is] she that is my rival; lower [is] she than they (f.) that are lower.

verses.sa:
अहमस्मि सहमानाथो त्वमसि सासहिः ।
उभे सहस्वती भूत्वा सपत्नीं मे सहावहै ॥
verses.rom:
ahamasmi sahamanatho tvamasi sasahih |
ubhe sahasvati bhutva sapatnim me sahavahai ||
verses.en: I am overpowering; likewise art thou very powerful; we both, becoming full of power, will overpower my rival.

verses.sa:
अभि तेऽधां सहमानामुप तेऽधां सहीयसीम् ।
मामनु प्र ते मनो वत्सं गौरिव धावतु पथा वारिव धावतु ॥
verses.rom:
abhi te'dham sahamanamupa te'dham sahiyasim |
mamanu pra te mano vatsam gauriva dhavatu patha variva dhavatu ||
verses.en: I have put on (abhí) for thee the overpowering one (f.); I have put

verses.sa:
संशितं म इदं ब्रह्म संशितं वीर्यं बलम् ।
संशितं क्षत्रमजरमस्तु जिष्णुर्येषामस्मि पुरोहितः ॥
verses.rom:
samshitam ma idam brahma samshitam viryam balam |
samshitam kshatramajaramastu jishnuryeshamasmi purohitah ||
verses.en: Sharpened up is this incantation (? bráhman) of mine; sharpened up [my] heroism, strength; sharpened up, victorious, be the unwasting authority (kṣatrá) [of them] of whom I am the household priest (puróhita).

verses.sa:
समहमेषां राष्ट्रं स्यामि समोजो वीर्यं बलम् ।
वृश्चामि शत्रूणां बाहून् अनेन हविषा अहम् ॥
verses.rom:
samahamesham rashtram syami samojo viryam balam |
vrishchami shatrunam bahun anena havisha aham ||
verses.en: Up I sharpen the royalty of them, up their force, heroism, strength; I hew [off] the arms of the foes with this oblation.

verses.sa:
नीचैः पद्यन्तामधरे भवन्तु ये नः सूरिं मघवानं पृतन्यान् ।
क्षिणामि ब्रह्मणामित्रान् उन् नयामि स्वान् अहम् ॥
verses.rom:
nichaih padyantamadhare bhavantu ye nah surim maghavanam pritanyan |
kshinami brahmanamitran un nayami svan aham ||
verses.en: Downward let them fall, let them become inferior, who shall fight against (pṛtany-) our bounteous patron (sūrí); I destroy the enemies by my incantation; I lead up our own men.

verses.sa:
तीक्ष्णीयांसः परशोरग्नेस्तीक्ष्णतरा उत ।
इन्द्रस्य वज्रात्तीक्ष्णीयांसो येषामस्मि पुरोहितः ॥
verses.rom:
tikshniyamsah parashoragnestikshnatara uta |
indrasya vajrattikshniyamso yeshamasmi purohitah ||
verses.en: Sharper than an ax, also sharper than fire, sharper than Indra's thunderbolt—[they] of whom I am the household priest.

verses.sa:
एषामहमायुधा सं स्याम्येषां राष्ट्रं सुवीरं वर्धयामि ।
एषां क्षत्रमजरमस्तु जिष्ण्वेषां चित्तं विश्वेऽवन्तु देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
eshamahamayudha sam syamyesham rashtram suviram vardhayami |
esham kshatramajaramastu jishnvesham chittam vishve'vantu devah ||
verses.en: The weapons of them I sharpen up; their royalty having good heroes, I increase; be their authority unwasting, victorious; their intent let all the gods aid.

verses.sa:
उद्धर्षन्तां मघवन् वाजिनान्युद्वीराणां जयतामेतु घोषः ।
पृथग्घोषा उलुलयः केतुमन्त उदीरताम् ।
देवा इन्द्रज्येष्ठा मरुतो यन्तु सेनया ॥
verses.rom:
uddharshantam maghavan vajinanyudviranam jayatametu ghoshah |
prithagghosha ululayah ketumanta udiratam |
deva indrajyeshtha maruto yantu senaya ||
verses.en: Let their energies (vā́jina) be excited, O bounteous one (maghávan); let the noise of the conquering heroes arise; let the noises, the clear (ketumánt) halloos, go up severally; let the divine Maruts, with Indra as their chief, go with the army.

verses.sa:
प्रेता जयता नर उग्रा वः सन्तु बाहवः ।
तीक्ष्णेषवोऽबलधन्वनो हतोग्रायुधा अबलान् उग्रबाहवः ॥
verses.rom:
preta jayata nara ugra vah santu bahavah |
tikshneshavo'baladhanvano hatograyudha abalan ugrabahavah ||
verses.en: Go forth, conquer, O men; formidable be your arms (bāhú); having sharp arrows, slay them of weak bows; having formidable weapons, having formidable arms (bāhú), [slay] the weak ones.

verses.sa:
अवसृष्टा परा पत शरव्ये ब्रह्मसंशिते ।
जय अमित्रान् प्र पद्यस्व जह्येषां वरंवरं मामीषां मोचि कश्चन ॥
verses.rom:
avasrishta para pata sharavye brahmasamshite |
jaya amitran pra padyasva jahyesham varamvaram mamisham mochi kashchana ||
verses.en: Being let loose, fly thou away, O volley, thou that art sharpened up

verses.sa:
अयं ते योनिर्ऋत्वियो यतो जातो अरोचथाः ।
तं जानन्न् अग्न आ रोहाधा नो वर्धय रयिम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam te yonirritviyo yato jato arochathah |
tam janann agna a rohadha no vardhaya rayim ||
verses.en: This is thy seasonable womb (yóni), whence born thou didst shine; knowing it, O Agni, ascend thou; then increase our wealth.

verses.sa:
अग्ने अच्छा वदेह नः प्रत्यङ्नः सुमना भव ।
प्र णो यच्छ विशां पते धनदा असि नस्त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne achchha vadeha nah pratyannah sumana bhava |
pra no yachchha visham pate dhanada asi nastvam ||
verses.en: O Agni, speak unto us here; be turned toward us with good-will; bestow upon us, O lord of the people (víç); giver of riches art thou to us.

verses.sa:
प्र णो यच्छत्वर्यमा प्र भगः प्र बृहस्पतिः ।
प्र देवीः प्रोत सूनृता रयिं देवी दधातु मे ॥
verses.rom:
pra no yachchhatvaryama pra bhagah pra brihaspatih |
pra devih prota sunrita rayim devi dadhatu me ||
verses.en: Let Aryaman bestow upon us, let Bhaga, let Brihaspati, let the goddesses; let the divine Sūnṛtā also assign wealth to me.

verses.sa:
सोमं राजानमवसेऽग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ।
आदित्यं विष्णुं सूर्यं ब्रह्माणं च बृहस्पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
somam rajanamavase'gnim girbhirhavamahe |
adityam vishnum suryam brahmanam cha brihaspatim ||
verses.en: King Soma [and] Agni we call to aid with [our] songs (gír); [also] Āditya, Vishṇu, Sūrya, and the priest (brahmán) Brihaspati.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं वर्धय ।
त्वं नो देव दातवे रयिं दानाय चोदय ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne agnibhirbrahma yajnam vardhaya |
tvam no deva datave rayim danaya chodaya ||
verses.en: Do thou, O Agni, with the fires (agní), increase our worship (bráhman) and sacrifice; do thou, O god, stir us up to give, unto giving wealth.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रवायू उभाविह सुहवेह हवामहे ।
यथा नः सर्व इज्जनः संगत्यां सुमना असद्दानकामश्च नो भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
indravayu ubhaviha suhaveha havamahe |
yatha nah sarva ijjanah samgatyam sumana asaddanakamashcha no bhuvat ||
verses.en: Indra-and-Vāyu, both of them here, we call here with good call, that to us even every man may be well-willing in intercourse, and may become desirous of giving to us.

verses.sa:
अर्यमणं बृहस्पतिमिन्द्रं दानाय चोदय ।
वातं विष्णुं सरस्वतीं सवितारं च वाजिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
aryamanam brihaspatimindram danaya chodaya |
vatam vishnum sarasvatim savitaram cha vajinam ||
verses.en: Do thou stir up Aryaman, Brihaspati, Indra, unto giving; [also] Vāta (wind), Vishṇu, Sarasvatī, and the vigorous (vājín) Savitar.

verses.sa:
वाजस्य नु प्रसवे सं बभूविमेमा च विश्वा भुवनानि अन्तः ।
उतादित्सन्तं दापयतु प्रजानन् रयिं च नः सर्ववीरं नि यच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
vajasya nu prasave sam babhuvimema cha vishva bhuvanani antah |
utaditsantam dapayatu prajanan rayim cha nah sarvaviram ni yachchha ||
verses.en: In the impulse (prasavá) of vigor (? vā́ja) now have we come into being, and all these beings within. Both let him, foreknowing, cause him

verses.sa:
दुह्रां मे पञ्च प्रदिशो दुह्रामुर्वीर्यथाबलम् ।
प्रापेयं सर्वा आकूतीर्मनसा हृदयेन च ॥
verses.rom:
duhram me pancha pradisho duhramurviryathabalam |
prapeyam sarva akutirmanasa hridayena cha ||
verses.en: Let the five directions yield (duh) to me, let the wide ones yield according to their strength; may I obtain all my designs, with mind and heart.

verses.sa:
गोसनिं वाचमुदेयं वर्चसा माभ्युदिहि ।
आ रुन्धां सर्वतो वायुस्त्वष्टा पोषं दधातु मे ॥
verses.rom:
gosanim vachamudeyam varchasa mabhyudihi |
a rundham sarvato vayustvashta posham dadhatu me ||
verses.en: A kine-winning voice may I speak; with splendor do thou arise upon me; let Vāyu (wind) enclose (ā-rudh) on all sides; let Tvashṭar assign to me abundance.

verses.sa:
ये अग्नयो अप्स्वन्तर्ये वृत्रे ये पुरुषे ये अश्मसु ।
य आविवेशोषधीर्यो वनस्पतींस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत् ॥
verses.rom:
ye agnayo apsvantarye vritre ye purushe ye ashmasu |
ya aviveshoshadhiryo vanaspatimstebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat ||
verses.en: The fires that are within the waters, that are in Vṛtra, that are in man, that are in stones, the one that hath entered the herbs, the forest-trees—to those fires be this oblation made.

verses.sa:
यः सोमे अन्तर्यो गोष्वन्तर्य आविष्टो वयःसु यो मृगेषु ।
य आविवेश द्विपदो यस्चतुष्पदस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत् ॥
verses.rom:
yah some antaryo goshvantarya avishto vayahsu yo mrigeshu |
ya avivesha dvipado yaschatushpadastebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat ||
verses.en: [The fire] that is within soma, that is within the kine, that is entered into the birds, into the wild beasts (mṛgá), that entered into bipeds, into quadrupeds—to those fires be this oblation made.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्रेण सरथं याति देवो वैश्वानर उत विश्वदाव्यः ।
यं जोहवीमि पृतनासु सासहिं तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत् ॥
verses.rom:
ya indrena saratham yati devo vaishvanara uta vishvadavyah |
yam johavimi pritanasu sasahim tebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat ||
verses.en: He who, a god, goes in the same chariot with Indra, he that belongs to all men (vāiçvānará) and to all gods (?), whom, very powerful in fights, I call loudly on—to those fires be this oblation made.

verses.sa:
यो देवो विश्वाद्यमु काममाहुर्यं दातारं प्रतिगृह्णन्तमाहुः ।
यो धीरः शक्रः परिभूरदाभ्यस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत् ॥
verses.rom:
yo devo vishvadyamu kamamahuryam dataram pratigrihnantamahuh |
yo dhirah shakrah paribhuradabhyastebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat ||
verses.en: He who is the all-eating god, and whom they call Desire (kā́ma), whom they call giver, receiving one, who is wise, mighty, encompassing, unharmable—to those fires be this oblation made.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा होतारं मनसाभि संविदुस्त्रयोदश भौवनाः पञ्च मानवाः ।
वर्चोधसे यशसे सूनृतावते तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत् ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva hotaram manasabhi samvidustrayodasha bhauvanah pancha manavah |
varchodhase yashase sunritavate tebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat ||
verses.en: Thou on whom as priest (hótar) agreed with their mind the thirteen kinds of beings (bhāuvaná), the five races of men (mānavá): to the splendor-bestowing, glorious one, rich in pleasantness—to those fires be this oblation made.

verses.sa:
उक्षान्नाय वशान्नाय सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे ।
वैश्वानरज्येष्ठेभ्यस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत् ॥
verses.rom:
ukshannaya vashannaya somaprishthaya vedhase |
vaishvanarajyeshthebhyastebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat ||
verses.en: To him whose food is oxen, whose food is cows, to the soma-backed, the pious: to those of whom the one for all men (vāiçvānará-) is chief—to those fires be this oblation made.

verses.sa:
दिवं पृथिवीमन्वन्तरिक्षं ये विद्युतमनुसंचरन्ति ।
ये दिक्ष्वन्तर्ये वाते अन्तस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत् ॥
verses.rom:
divam prithivimanvantariksham ye vidyutamanusamcharanti |
ye dikshvantarye vate antastebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat ||
verses.en: They who move on along the sky, the earth, the atmosphere, along the lightning; who are within the quarters, who within the wind—to those fires be this oblation made.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यपाणिं सवितारमिन्द्रं बृहस्पतिं वरुणं मित्रमग्निम् ।
विश्वान् देवान् अङ्गिरसो हवामहे इमं क्रव्यादं शमयन्त्वग्निम् ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyapanim savitaramindram brihaspatim varunam mitramagnim |
vishvan devan angiraso havamahe imam kravyadam shamayantvagnim ||
verses.en: Gold-handed Savitar, Indra, Brihaspati, Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni, all the gods, the Angirases, do we call; let them appease (çam) this flesh-eating fire.

verses.sa:
शान्तो अग्निः क्रव्याच्छान्तः पुरुषरेषणः ।
अथो यो विश्वदाव्यस्तं क्रव्यादमशीशमम् ॥
verses.rom:
shanto agnih kravyachchhantah purushareshanah |
atho yo vishvadavyastam kravyadamashishamam ||
verses.en: Appeased is the flesh-eating, appeased the men-injuring fire; so also the one that is of all conflagrations, him, the flesh-eating, have I appeased.

verses.sa:
ये पर्वताः सोमपृष्ठा आप उत्तानशीवरीः ।
वातः पर्जन्य आदग्निस्ते क्रव्यादमशीशमन् ॥
verses.rom:
ye parvatah somaprishtha apa uttanashivarih |
vatah parjanya adagniste kravyadamashishaman ||
verses.en: The mountains that are soma-backed, the waters that lie supine,

verses.sa:
हस्तिवर्चसं प्रथतां बृहद्यशो अदित्या यत्तन्वः संबभूव ।
तत्सर्वे समदुर्मह्यमेतद्विश्वे देवा अदितिः सजोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
hastivarchasam prathatam brihadyasho aditya yattanvah sambabhuva |
tatsarve samadurmahyametadvishve deva aditih sajoshah ||
verses.en: Let elephant-splendor, great glory, spread itself, which came into being from Aditi's body; that same have all together given to me—all the gods, Aditi, in unison.

verses.sa:
मित्रश्च वरुणश्चेन्द्रो रुद्रश्च चेततु ।
देवासो विश्वधायसस्ते माञ्जन्तु वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
mitrashcha varunashchendro rudrashcha chetatu |
devaso vishvadhayasaste manjantu varchasa ||
verses.en: Let both Mitra and Varuṇa, Indra and Rudra, [each] take notice; the all-nourishing gods—let them anoint me with splendor.

verses.sa:
येन हस्ती वर्चसा संबभूव येन राजा मनुष्येस्वप्स्वन्तः ।
येन देवा देवतामग्र आयन् तेन मामद्य वर्चसाग्ने वर्चस्विनं कृणु ॥
verses.rom:
yena hasti varchasa sambabhuva yena raja manushyesvapsvantah |
yena deva devatamagra ayan tena mamadya varchasagne varchasvinam krinu ||
verses.en: With what splendor the elephant came into being, with what the king among men (manuṣyà), among waters, with what the gods in the beginning went to godhood—with that splendor do thou, O Agni, now make me splendid.

verses.sa:
यत्ते वर्चो जातवेदो बृहद्भवत्याहुतेः ।
यावत्सूर्यस्य वर्च आसुरस्य च हस्तिनः ।
तावन् मे अश्विना वर्च आ धत्तां पुष्करस्रजा ॥
verses.rom:
yatte varcho jatavedo brihadbhavatyahuteh |
yavatsuryasya varcha asurasya cha hastinah |
tavan me ashvina varcha a dhattam pushkarasraja ||
verses.en: What great splendor becomes thine, O Jātavedas, from the offering; how great splendor there is of the sun, and of the ásura-like elephant—so great splendor let the (two) Açvins, lotus-wreathed, assign unto me.

verses.sa:
यावच्चतस्रः प्रदिशश्चक्षुर्यावत्समश्नुते ।
तावत्समैत्विन्द्रियं मयि तद्धस्तिवर्चसम् ॥
verses.rom:
yavachchatasrah pradishashchakshuryavatsamashnute |
tavatsamaitvindriyam mayi taddhastivarchasam ||
verses.en: As far as the four directions, as far as the eye reaches (sam-aç), let so great force (indriyá) come together, that elephant-splendor, in me.

verses.sa:
हस्ती मृगाणां सुषदामतिष्ठावान् बभूव हि ।
तस्य भगेन वर्चसाभि षिञ्चामि मामहम् ॥
verses.rom:
hasti mriganam sushadamatishthavan babhuva hi |
tasya bhagena varchasabhi shinchami mamaham ||
verses.en: Since the elephant has become the superior (atiṣṭhā́vant) of the comfortable (? suṣád) wild beasts, with his fortune [and] splendor do I pour (sic) upon myself.

verses.sa:
येन वेहद्बभूविथ नाशयामसि तत्त्वत्।
इदं तदन्यत्र त्वदप दूरे नि दध्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
yena vehadbabhuvitha nashayamasi tattvat|
idam tadanyatra tvadapa dure ni dadhmasi ||
verses.en: By what thou hast become barren (vehát), that we make disappear from thee; that now we set down elsewhere, far away from (ápa) thee.

verses.sa:
आ ते योनिं गर्भ एतु पुमान् बाण इवेषुधिम् ।
आ वीरोऽत्र जायतां पुत्रस्ते दशमास्यः ॥
verses.rom:
a te yonim garbha etu puman bana iveshudhim |
a viro'tra jayatam putraste dashamasyah ||
verses.en: Unto thy womb let a fœtus come, a male one, as an arrow to a quiver; let a hero be born unto thee here, a ten-months' son.

verses.sa:
पुमांसं पुत्रं जनय तं पुमान् अनु जायताम् ।
भवासि पुत्राणां माता जातानां जनयाश्च यान् ॥
verses.rom:
pumamsam putram janaya tam puman anu jayatam |
bhavasi putranam mata jatanam janayashcha yan ||
verses.en: Give birth to a male, a son; after him let a male be born; mayest thou be mother of sons, of those born and whom thou shalt bear.

verses.sa:
यानि भद्राणि बीजान्यृषभा जनयन्ति च ।
तैस्त्वं पुत्रं विन्दस्व सा प्रसूर्धेनुका भव ॥
verses.rom:
yani bhadrani bijanyrishabha janayanti cha |
taistvam putram vindasva sa prasurdhenuka bhava ||
verses.en: And what excellent seeds the bulls generate, with them do thou acquire (vid) a son; become thou a productive milch-cow.

verses.sa:
कृणोमि ते प्राजापत्यमा योनिं गर्भ एतु ते ।
विन्दस्व त्वं पुत्रं नारि यस्तुभ्यं शमसच्छमु तस्मै त्वं भव ॥
verses.rom:
krinomi te prajapatyama yonim garbha etu te |
vindasva tvam putram nari yastubhyam shamasachchhamu tasmai tvam bhava ||
verses.en: I perform for thee the [ceremony] of Prajāpati; let a fœtus come to thy womb; acquire thou a son, O woman, who shall be weal for thee; weal also for him do thou become.

verses.sa:
यासां द्यौः पिता पृथिवी माता समुद्रो मूलं वीरुधां बभूव ।
तास्त्वा पुत्रविद्याय दैवीः प्रावन्त्वोषधयः ॥
verses.rom:
yasam dyauh pita prithivi mata samudro mulam virudham babhuva |
tastva putravidyaya daivih pravantvoshadhayah ||
verses.en: The plants of which heaven has been the father, earth the mother, ocean the root—let those herbs of the gods (dāíva) favor thee, in order to acquisition of a son.

verses.sa:
पयस्वतीरोषधयः पयस्वन् मामकं वचः ।
अथो पयस्वतीनामा भरेऽहं सहस्रशः ॥
verses.rom:
payasvatiroshadhayah payasvan mamakam vachah |
atho payasvatinama bhare'ham sahasrashah ||
verses.en: Rich in milk [are] the herbs, rich in milk my utterance (vácas); accordingly, of them that are rich in milk I bring by thousands.

verses.sa:
वेदाहं पयस्वन्तं चकार धान्यं बहु ।
संभृत्वा नाम यो देवस्तं वयं हवामहे योयो अयज्वनो गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
vedaham payasvantam chakara dhanyam bahu |
sambhritva nama yo devastam vayam havamahe yoyo ayajvano grihe ||
verses.en: I know him that is rich in milk; he hath made the grain much; the god that is "collector" by name, him do we call, whichever is in the house of one who sacrifices not.

verses.sa:
इमा याः पञ्च प्रदिशो मानवीः पञ्च कृष्टयः ।
वृष्टे शापं नदीरिवेह स्फातिं समावहान् ॥
verses.rom:
ima yah pancha pradisho manavih pancha krishtayah |
vrishte shapam nadiriveha sphatim samavahan ||
verses.en: These five directions that there are, the five races (kṛṣṭí) descended from Manu (mānavī́)—may they bring fatness (sphātí) together here, as streams [bring] drift when it has rained.

verses.sa:
उदुत्सं शतधारं सहस्रधारमक्षितम् ।
एवास्माकेदं धान्यं सहस्रधारमक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
udutsam shatadharam sahasradharamakshitam |
evasmakedam dhanyam sahasradharamakshitam ||
verses.en: As a fountain of a hundred streams, of a thousand streams, unexhausted, so this grain of ours, in a thousand streams, unexhausted.

verses.sa:
शतहस्त समाहर सहस्रहस्त सं किर ।
कृतस्य कार्यस्य चेह स्फातिं समावह ॥
verses.rom:
shatahasta samahara sahasrahasta sam kira |
kritasya karyasya cheha sphatim samavaha ||
verses.en: O hundred-handed one, bring together; O thousand-handed one, pile together; of what is made and of what is to be made do thou convey together the fatness here.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो मात्रा गन्धर्वाणां चतस्रो गृहपत्न्याः ।
तासां या स्फातिमत्तमा तया त्वाभि मृशामसि ॥
verses.rom:
tisro matra gandharvanam chatasro grihapatnyah |
tasam ya sphatimattama taya tvabhi mrishamasi ||
verses.en: Three measures of the Gandharvas, four of the house-mistress; of them whichever is richest in fatness, with that one we touch thee.

verses.sa:
उपोहश्च समूहश्च क्षत्तारौ ते प्रजापते ।
ताविहा वहतां स्फातिं बहुं भूमानमक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
upohashcha samuhashcha kshattarau te prajapate |
taviha vahatam sphatim bahum bhumanamakshitam ||
verses.en: Bringer (upohá) and gatherer (samūhá) [are] thy (two) distributors, O Prajāpati; let them convey hither fatness, much unexhausted plenty.

verses.sa:
उत्तुदस्त्वोत्तुदतु मा धृथाः शयने स्वे ।
इषुः कामस्य या भीमा तया विध्यामि त्वा हृदि ॥
verses.rom:
uttudastvottudatu ma dhrithah shayane sve |
ishuh kamasya ya bhima taya vidhyami tva hridi ||
verses.en: Let the up-thruster thrust (tud) thee up; do not abide (dhṛ) in thine own lair; the arrow of love (kā́ma) that is terrible, therewith I pierce thee in the heart.

verses.sa:
आधीपर्णां कामशल्यामिषुं संकल्पकुल्मलाम् ।
तां सुसंनतां कृत्वा कामो विध्यतु त्वा हृदि ॥
verses.rom:
adhiparnam kamashalyamishum samkalpakulmalam |
tam susamnatam kritva kamo vidhyatu tva hridi ||
verses.en: The arrow feathered with longing (ādhī́), tipped with love, necked with resolve (? saṁkalpá-)—having made that well-straightened, let love pierce thee in the heart.

verses.sa:
या प्लीहानं शोषयति कामस्येषुः सुसंनता ।
प्राचीनपक्षा व्योषा तया विध्यामि त्वा हृदि ॥
verses.rom:
ya plihanam shoshayati kamasyeshuh susamnata |
prachinapaksha vyosha taya vidhyami tva hridi ||
verses.en: The well-straightened arrow of love which dries the spleen, forward-winged, consuming (vyòṣa)—therewith I pierce thee in the heart.

verses.sa:
शुचा विद्धा व्योषया शुष्कास्याभि सर्प मा ।
मृदुर्निमन्युः केवली प्रियवादिन्यनुव्रता ॥
verses.rom:
shucha viddha vyoshaya shushkasyabhi sarpa ma |
mridurnimanyuh kevali priyavadinyanuvrata ||
verses.en: Pierced with consuming pain (çúc), dry-mouthed, do thou come creeping to me, gentle, with fury allayed, entirely [mine], pleasant-spoken, submissive.

verses.sa:
आजामि त्वाजन्या परि मातुरथो पितुः ।
यथा मम क्रतावसो मम चित्तमुपायसि ॥
verses.rom:
ajami tvajanya pari maturatho pituh |
yatha mama kratavaso mama chittamupayasi ||
verses.en: I goad thee hither with a goad (ā́janī), away from mother, likewise from father, that thou mayest be in my power (krátu), mayest come unto my intent.

verses.sa:
व्यस्यै मित्रावरुणौ हृदश्चित्तान्यस्यतम् ।
अथैनामक्रतुं कृत्वा ममैव कृणुतं वशे ॥
verses.rom:
vyasyai mitravarunau hridashchittanyasyatam |
athainamakratum kritva mamaiva krinutam vashe ||
verses.en: Do ye, O Mitra-and-Varuṇa, cast out the intents from her heart; then, making her powerless, make her [to be] in my own control.

verses.sa:
येऽस्यां स्थ प्राच्यां दिशि हेतयो नाम देवास्तेषां वो अग्निरिषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
ye'syam stha prachyam dishi hetayo nama devastesham vo agnirishavah |
te no mridata te no'dhi bruta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vah svaha ||
verses.en: Ye gods that are in this eastern quarter, missiles by name—of you there the arrows are fire: do ye be gracious to us, do ye bless (adhi-brū) us; to you there be homage, to you there hail!

verses.sa:
येऽस्यां स्थ दक्षिणायां दिश्यविष्यवो नाम देवास्तेषां वः काम इषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
ye'syam stha dakshinayam dishyavishyavo nama devastesham vah kama ishavah |
te no mridata te no'dhi bruta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vah svaha ||
verses.en: Ye gods that are in this southern quarter, impetuous (? aviṣyú) by name—of you there the arrows are love (kā́ma): do ye be etc. etc.

verses.sa:
येऽस्यां स्थ प्रतीच्यां दिशि वैराजा नाम देवास्तेषां व आप इषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
ye'syam stha pratichyam dishi vairaja nama devastesham va apa ishavah |
te no mridata te no'dhi bruta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vah svaha ||
verses.en: Ye gods that are in this western quarter, vāirājás by name—of you there the arrows are the waters: do ye be etc. etc.

verses.sa:
येऽस्यां स्थोदीच्यां दिशि प्रविध्यन्तो नाम देवास्तेषां वो वात इषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
ye'syam sthodichyam dishi pravidhyanto nama devastesham vo vata ishavah |
te no mridata te no'dhi bruta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vah svaha ||
verses.en: Ye gods that are in this northern quarter, piercing by name—of you there the arrows are wind: do ye be etc. etc.

verses.sa:
येऽस्यां स्थ ध्रुवायां दिशि निलिम्पा नाम देवास्तेषां व ओषधीरिषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
ye'syam stha dhruvayam dishi nilimpa nama devastesham va oshadhirishavah |
te no mridata te no'dhi bruta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vah svaha ||
verses.en: Ye gods that are in this fixed quarter, smearers (nilimpá) by name—of you there the arrows are the herbs: do ye be etc. etc.

verses.sa:
येऽस्यां स्थोर्ध्वायां दिश्यवस्वन्तो नाम देवास्तेषां वो बृहस्पतिरिषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
ye'syam sthordhvayam dishyavasvanto nama devastesham vo brihaspatirishavah |
te no mridata te no'dhi bruta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vah svaha ||
verses.en: Ye gods that are in this upward quarter, helpful (ávasvant) by name—of you there the arrows are Brihaspati: do ye be etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्राची दिगग्निरधिपतिरसितो रक्षितादित्या इषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः ॥
verses.rom:
prachi digagniradhipatirasito rakshitaditya ishavah |
tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakshitribhyo nama ishubhyo nama ebhyo astu |
yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmastam vo jambhe dadhmah ||
verses.en: Eastern quarter; Agni overlord; black serpent defender; the Ādityas arrows: homage to those overlords; homage to the defenders; homage to the arrows; homage be to them; who hates us, whom we hate, him we put in your jaws (jámbha).

verses.sa:
दक्षिणा दिगिन्द्रोऽधिपतिस्तिरश्चिराजी रक्षिता पितर इषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः ॥
verses.rom:
dakshina digindro'dhipatistirashchiraji rakshita pitara ishavah |
tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakshitribhyo nama ishubhyo nama ebhyo astu |
yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmastam vo jambhe dadhmah ||
verses.en: Southern quarter; Indra overlord; cross-lined [serpent] defender; the Fathers arrows: homage to those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्रतीची दिग्वरुणोऽधिपतिः पृदाकू रक्षितान्नमिषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः ॥
verses.rom:
pratichi digvaruno'dhipatih pridaku rakshitannamishavah |
tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakshitribhyo nama ishubhyo nama ebhyo astu |
yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmastam vo jambhe dadhmah ||
verses.en: Western quarter; Varuna overlord; the adder (pṛ́dāku) defender; food the arrows: homage to those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
उदीची दिक्सोमोऽधिपतिः स्वजो रक्षिताशनिरिषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः ॥
verses.rom:
udichi diksomo'dhipatih svajo rakshitashanirishavah |
tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakshitribhyo nama ishubhyo nama ebhyo astu |
yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmastam vo jambhe dadhmah ||
verses.en: Northern quarter; Soma overlord; the constrictor (svajá) defender; the thunderbolt (açáni) arrows: homage to those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवा दिग्विष्णुरधिपतिः कल्माषग्रीवो रक्षिता वीरुध इषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva digvishnuradhipatih kalmashagrivo rakshita virudha ishavah |
tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakshitribhyo nama ishubhyo nama ebhyo astu |
yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmastam vo jambhe dadhmah ||
verses.en: Fixed quarter; Vishṇu overlord; the serpent with black-spotted (kalmā́ṣa-) neck defender; the plants arrows: homage to those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वा दिग्बृहस्पतिरधिपतिः श्वित्रो रक्षिता वर्षमिषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः ॥
verses.rom:
urdhva digbrihaspatiradhipatih shvitro rakshita varshamishavah |
tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakshitribhyo nama ishubhyo nama ebhyo astu |
yo'sman dveshti yam vayam dvishmastam vo jambhe dadhmah ||
verses.en: Upward quarter; Brihaspati overlord; the white (çvitrá) [serpent] defender; rain the arrows: homage to those etc. etc.

verses.sa:
