एकैकयैषा सृष्ट्या सं बभूव यत्र गा असृजन्त भूतकृतो विश्वरूपाः ।
यत्र विजायते यमिन्यपर्तुः सा पशून् क्षिणाति रिफती रुशती ॥
verses.rom:
ekaikayaisha srishtya sam babhuva yatra ga asrijanta bhutakrito vishvarupah |
yatra vijayate yaminyapartuh sa pashun kshinati riphati rushati ||
verses.en: She herself came into being by a one-by-one creation, where the being-makers created the kine of all forms; where the twinning [cow] gives birth, out of season, she destroys the cattle, snarling, angry.

verses.sa:
एषा पशून्त्सं क्षिणाति क्रव्याद्भूत्वा व्यद्वरी ।
उतैनां ब्रह्मणे दद्यात्तथा स्योना शिवा स्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
esha pashuntsam kshinati kravyadbhutva vyadvari |
utainam brahmane dadyattatha syona shiva syat ||
verses.en: She quite destroys the cattle, becoming a flesh-eater, devourer (? vy-ádvarī); also one should give her to a priest (brahmán); so would she be pleasant, propitious.

verses.sa:
शिवा भव पुरुषेभ्यो गोभ्यो अश्वेभ्यः शिवा ।
शिवास्मै सर्वस्मै क्षेत्राय शिवा न इहैधि ॥
verses.rom:
shiva bhava purushebhyo gobhyo ashvebhyah shiva |
shivasmai sarvasmai kshetraya shiva na ihaidhi ||
verses.en: Be thou propitious to men (púruṣa), propitious to kine, to horses, propitious to all this field (kṣétra); be propitious to us here.

verses.sa:
इह पुष्टिरिह रस इह सहस्रसातमा भव ।
पशून् यमिनि पोषय ॥
verses.rom:
iha pushtiriha rasa iha sahasrasatama bhava |
pashun yamini poshaya ||
verses.en: Here prosperity, here sap—here be thou best winner of a thousand; make the cattle prosper, O twinning one.

verses.sa:
यत्रा सुहार्दः सुकृतो मदन्ति विहाय रोगं तन्वः स्वायाः ।
तं लोकं यमिन्यभिसंबभूव सा नो मा हिंसीत्पुरुषान् पशूंश्च ॥
verses.rom:
yatra suhardah sukrito madanti vihaya rogam tanvah svayah |
tam lokam yaminyabhisambabhuva sa no ma himsitpurushan pashumshcha ||
verses.en: Where the good-hearted [and] well-doing revel, quitting disease of their own body—into that world hath the twinning one come into being; let her not injure our men and cattle.

verses.sa:
यत्रा सुहार्दां सुकृतामग्निहोत्रहुतां यत्र लोकः ।
तं लोकं यमिन्यभिसंबभूव सा नो मा हिंसीत्पुरुषान् पशूंश्च ॥
verses.rom:
yatra suhardam sukritamagnihotrahutam yatra lokah |
tam lokam yaminyabhisambabhuva sa no ma himsitpurushan pashumshcha ||
verses.en: Where is the world of the good-hearted, of the well-doing, where of them that offer the fire-offering (agnihotrá-)—into that world hath the twinning one come into being; let her not injure our men and cattle.

verses.sa:
यद्राजानो विभजन्त इष्टापूर्तस्य षोडशं यमस्यामी सभासदः ।
अविस्तस्मात्प्र मुञ्चति दत्तः शितिपात्स्वधा ॥
verses.rom:
yadrajano vibhajanta ishtapurtasya shodasham yamasyami sabhasadah |
avistasmatpra munchati dattah shitipatsvadha ||

verses.sa:
सर्वान् कामान् पूरयत्याभवन् प्रभवन् भवन् ।
आकूतिप्रोऽविर्दत्तः शितिपान्न् नोप दस्यति ॥
verses.rom:
sarvan kaman purayatyabhavan prabhavan bhavan |
akutipro'virdattah shitipann nopa dasyati ||

verses.sa:
यो ददाति शितिपादमविं लोकेन संमितम् ।
स नाकमभ्यारोहति यत्र शुल्को न क्रियते अबलेन बलीयसे ॥
verses.rom:
yo dadati shitipadamavim lokena sammitam |
sa nakamabhyarohati yatra shulko na kriyate abalena baliyase ||

verses.sa:
पञ्चापूपं शितिपादमविं लोकेन संमितम् ।
प्रदातोप जीवति पितॄणां लोकेऽक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
panchapupam shitipadamavim lokena sammitam |
pradatopa jivati pitrinam loke'kshitam ||

verses.sa:
पञ्चापूपं शितिपादमविं लोकेन संमितम् ।
प्रदातोप जीवति सूर्यामासयोरक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
panchapupam shitipadamavim lokena sammitam |
pradatopa jivati suryamasayorakshitam ||

verses.sa:
इरेव नोप दस्यति समुद्र इव पयो महत्।
देवौ सवासिनाविव शितिपान् नोप दस्यति ॥
verses.rom:
ireva nopa dasyati samudra iva payo mahat|
devau savasinaviva shitipan nopa dasyati ||

verses.sa:
क इदं कस्मा अदात्कामः कामायादात्।
कामो दाता कामः प्रतिग्रहीता कामः समुद्रमा विवेश ।
कामेन त्वा प्रति गृह्णामि कामैतत्ते ॥
verses.rom:
ka idam kasma adatkamah kamayadat|
kamo data kamah pratigrahita kamah samudrama vivesha |
kamena tva prati grihnami kamaitatte ||

verses.sa:
भूमिष्ट्वा प्रति गृह्णात्वन्तरिक्षमिदं महत्।
माहं प्राणेन मात्मना मा प्रजया प्रतिगृह्य वि राधिषि ॥
verses.rom:
bhumishtva prati grihnatvantarikshamidam mahat|
maham pranena matmana ma prajaya pratigrihya vi radhishi ||

prose.en:
1. What the kings share among themselves—the sixteenth of what is offered-and-bestowed—yon assessors (sabhāsád) of Yama: from that the white-footed sheep, given [as] ancestral offering (svadhā́), releases.

2. All desires (kā́ma) it fulfils, arising (ā-bhū), coming forth (pra-bhū), becoming (bhū); [as] fulfiller of designs, the white-footed sheep, being given, is not exhausted (upa-das).

3. He who gives a white-footed sheep commensurate (sámmita) with [his] world, he ascends unto the firmament, where a tax is not paid (kṛ) by a weak man for a stronger.

4. The white-footed sheep, accompanied with five cakes, commensurate with [his] world, the giver lives upon, [as] unexhausted in the world of the Fathers.

5. The white-footed sheep, accompanied with five cakes, commensurate with [his] world, the giver lives upon, [as] unexhausted in the sun and moon.

6. Like refreshing drink (írā), it is not exhausted; like the ocean, a great draught (páyas); like the two jointly-dwelling gods, the white-footed one is not exhausted.

7. Who hath given this to whom? Love hath given unto love; love [is] giver, love acceptor; love entered into the ocean; with love I accept thee; love, that for thee!

verses.sa:
सहृदयं सांमनस्यमविद्वेषं कृणोमि वः ।
अन्यो अन्यमभि हर्यत वत्सं जातमिवाघ्न्या ॥
verses.rom:
sahridayam sammanasyamavidvesham krinomi vah |
anyo anyamabhi haryata vatsam jatamivaghnya ||
verses.en: Like-heartedness, like-mindedness, non-hostility do I make for you; do ye show affection (hary) the one toward the other, as the inviolable [cow] toward her calf when born.

verses.sa:
अनुव्रतः पितुः पुत्रो मात्रा भवतु संमनाः ।
जाया पत्ये मधुमतीं वाचं वदतु शन्तिवाम् ॥
verses.rom:
anuvratah pituh putro matra bhavatu sammanah |
jaya patye madhumatim vacham vadatu shantivam ||
verses.en: Be the son submissive to the father, like-minded with the mother; let the wife to the husband speak words (vā́c) full of honey, wealful.

verses.sa:
मा भ्राता भ्रातरं द्विक्षन् मा स्वसारमुत स्वसा ।
सम्यञ्चः सव्रता भूत्वा वाचं वदत भद्रया ॥
verses.rom:
ma bhrata bhrataram dvikshan ma svasaramuta svasa |
samyanchah savrata bhutva vacham vadata bhadraya ||
verses.en: Let not brother hate brother, nor sister sister; becoming accordant (samyáñc), of like courses, speak ye words auspiciously (bhadráyā).

verses.sa:
येन देवा न वियन्ति नो च विद्विषते मिथः ।
तत्कृण्मो ब्रह्म वो गृहे संज्ञानं पुरुषेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yena deva na viyanti no cha vidvishate mithah |
tatkrinmo brahma vo grihe samjnanam purushebhyah ||
verses.en: That incantation in virtue of which the gods do not go apart, nor hate one another mutually, we perform in your house, concord for [your] men (púruṣa).

verses.sa:
ज्यायस्वन्तश्चित्तिनो मा वि यौष्ट संराधयन्तः सधुराश्चरन्तः ।
अन्यो अन्यस्मै वल्गु वदन्त एत सध्रीचीनान् वः संमनसस्क्र्णोमि ॥
verses.rom:
jyayasvantashchittino ma vi yaushta samradhayantah sadhurashcharantah |
anyo anyasmai valgu vadanta eta sadhrichinan vah sammanasaskrnomi ||
verses.en: Having superiors (jyā́yasvant), intentful, be ye not divided, accomplishing together, moving on with joint labor (sádhura); come hither speaking what is agreeable one to another; I make you united (sadhrīcī́na), like-minded.

verses.sa:
समानी प्रपा सह वोऽन्नभागः समाने योक्त्रे सह वो युनज्मि ।
सम्यञ्चोऽग्निं सपर्यतारा नाभिमिवाभितः ॥
verses.rom:
samani prapa saha vo'nnabhagah samane yoktre saha vo yunajmi |
samyancho'gnim saparyatara nabhimivabhitah ||
verses.en: Your drinking (prapā́) [be] the same, in common your share of

verses.sa:
सध्रीचीनान् वः संमनसस्कृणोम्येकश्नुष्टीन्त्संवननेन सर्वान् ।
देवा इवामृतं रक्षमाणाः सायंप्रातः सौमनसो वो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
sadhrichinan vah sammanasaskrinomyekashnushtintsamvananena sarvan |
deva ivamritam rakshamanah sayampratah saumanaso vo astu ||
verses.en: United, like-minded I make you, of one bunch, all of you, by [my] conciliation; [be] like the gods defending immortality (amṛ́ta); late and early be well-willing yours.

verses.sa:
वि देवा जरसावृतन् वि त्वमग्ने अरात्या ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
vi deva jarasavritan vi tvamagne aratya |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: The gods have turned away from old age; thou, O Agni; away from the niggard; I away from all evil [have turned], away from yákṣma, to union (sám) with life-time.

verses.sa:
व्यार्त्या पवमानो वि शक्रः पापकृत्यया ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
vyartya pavamano vi shakrah papakrityaya |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: The cleansing one [has turned] away from mishap (ā́rti), the mighty one (çakrá) away from evil-doing; I away from etc. etc.

verses.sa:
वि ग्राम्याः पशव आरण्यैर्व्यापस्तृष्णयासरन् ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
vi gramyah pashava aranyairvyapastrishnayasaran |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: The animals (paçú) of the village [have turned] away from those

verses.sa:
वी मे द्यावापृथिवी इतो वि पन्थानो दिशंदिशम् ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
vi me dyavaprithivi ito vi panthano dishamdisham |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: Apart [from one another] go heaven-and-earth here (imé), away the roads, to one and another quarter; I away from etc. etc.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा दुहित्रे वहतुं युनक्तीतीदं विश्वं भुवनं वि याति ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
tvashta duhitre vahatum yunaktitidam vishvam bhuvanam vi yati |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: Tvashṭar harnesses (yuj) for his daughter a wedding-car (vahatú); at the news, all this creation (bhúvana) goes away; I away from etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अग्निः प्राणान्त्सं दधाति चन्द्रः प्राणेन संहितः ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
agnih pranantsam dadhati chandrah pranena samhitah |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: Agni puts together the breaths; the moon is put together with breath: I away from etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्राणेन विश्वतोवीर्यं देवाः सूर्यं समैरयन् ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
pranena vishvatoviryam devah suryam samairayan |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: By breath did the gods set in motion (sam-īray) the sun, of universal heroism: I away from etc. etc.

verses.sa:
आयुष्मतामायुष्कृतां प्राणेन जीव मा मृथाः ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
ayushmatamayushkritam pranena jiva ma mrithah |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: By the breath of the long-lived, of the life-makers (āyuṣkṛ́t), do thou live; do not die: I away from etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्राणेन प्राणतां प्राणेहैव भव मा मृथाः ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
pranena pranatam pranehaiva bhava ma mrithah |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: With the breath of the breathing do thou breathe; be just here; do not die: I away from etc. etc.

verses.sa:
उदायुषा समायुषोदोषधीनां रसेन ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
udayusha samayushodoshadhinam rasena |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: Up with life-time; together with life-time; up with the sap of the herbs: I away from etc. etc.

verses.sa:
आ पर्जन्यस्य वृष्ट्योदस्थामामृता वयम् ।
व्यहं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा ॥
verses.rom:
a parjanyasya vrishtyodasthamamrita vayam |
vyaham sarvena papmana vi yakshmena samayusha ||
verses.en: Hither with Parjanya's rain have we stood up immortal: I away from etc. etc.
